anything else is ambiguous.\n+_LONG = {\"Buy\", \"Overweight\"}\n+_SHORT = {\"Sell\", \"Underweight\"}\n+_HOLD = {\"Hold\"}\n+_ACTIONABLE = _LONG | _SHORT\n+\n+\n+def _is_finite(value) -> bool:\n+    return (\n+        isinstance(value, (int, float))\n+        and not isinstance(value, bool)\n+        and math.isfinite(value)\n+    )\n+\n+\n+def _direction(action: str | None, rating: str | None) -> tuple[str | None, bool]:\n+    \"\"\"Resolve the decision direction and whether it is unambiguous.\n+\n+    Returns ``(direction, consistent)`` where ``direction`` is ``\"long\"``,\n+    ``\"short\"``, ``\"hold\"``, or ``None`` (unknown). ``consistent`` is ``False``\n+    when the action and the model rating point in opposite directions.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    a = action if action in (_LONG | _SHORT | _HOLD) else None\n+    r = rating if rating in (_LONG | _SHORT | _HOLD) else None\n+\n+    a_bucket = \"long\" if a in _LONG else \"short\" if a in _SHORT else \"hold\" if a in _HOLD else None\n+    r_bucket = \"long\" if r in _LONG else \"short\" if r in _SHORT else \"hold\" if r in _HOLD else None\n+\n+    if a_bucket and r_bucket and a_bucket != r_bucket:\n+        return None, False\n+    direction = a_bucket or r_bucket\n+    return direction, True\n+\n+\n+def _rule(rule_id: str, outcome: RuleOutcome, detail: str = \"\",\n+          observed: float | None = None, threshold: float | None = None) -> RuleResult:\n+    return RuleResult(rule_id=rule_id, outcome=outcome, detail=detail,\n+                      observed=observed, threshold=threshold)\n+\n+\n+def _evaluate_integrity(inputs: RiskInputs, direction, consistent: bool) -> RuleResult:\n+    \"\"\"R6: inputs present, finite, consistent, direction unambiguous, affordable.\n+\n+    Records UNKNOWN for: contradictory direction, ambiguous direction, non-finite\n+    prices, an unusable/inconsistent/stale portfolio snapshot, and a purchase the\n+    cash cannot fund. R6 does not duplicate the cap (R2) or sector (R3) checks.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    if not consistent:\n+        return _rule(R6, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, \"action and model_rating disagree on direction\")\n+    if direction is None:\n+        return _rule(R6, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, \"direction is ambiguous\")\n+    if direction == \"short\":\n+        # v1 supports ordinary cash-funded long BUY only. A short/SELL cannot be\n+        # approved pending team confirmation of risk-reducing criteria.\n+        return _rule(R6, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN,\n+                     \"short/SELL is unsupported in v1 (pending team confirmation)\")\n+    for name, value in ((\"entry_price\", inputs.entry_price),\n+                        (\"stop_loss\", inputs.stop_loss),\n+                        (\"price_target\", inputs.price_target)):\n+        if value is not None and not _is_finite(value):\n+            return _rule(R6, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, f\"{name} is not finite\")\n+\n+    portfolio = inputs.portfolio\n+    if portfolio is not None:\n+        try:\n+            validate_snapshot(portfolio, inputs.trade_date)\n+        except SnapshotError as exc:\n+            return _rule(R6, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, f\"portfolio snapshot unusable: {exc}\")\n+\n+        # Affordability of a cash-funded increase, when the buy size is known.\n+        tp = inputs.target_position\n+        if tp is not None and weight_problem(tp.target_position_weight) is None:\n+            weight = tp.target_position_weight\n+            current = current_stock_value(portfolio, inputs.ticker)\n+            projected = projected_stock_value(weight, portfolio.portfolio_value)\n+            increase = projected - current\n+            if increase > portfolio.cash + 1e-9:\n+                return _rule(R6, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN,\n+                             \"purchase is not affordable from available cash\",\n+                             observed=increase, threshold=portfolio.cash)\n+    return _rule(R6, RuleOutcome.PASS, \"inputs are present and consistent\")\n+\n+\n+def _evaluate_stop_loss(inputs: RiskInputs, direction) -> RuleResult:\n+    \"\"\"R1: a long actionable BUY must carry a stop-loss. HOLD/SHORT are N/A here.\"\"\"\n+    if direction != \"long\":\n+        return _rule(R1, RuleOutcome.NOT_APPLICABLE, \"stop-loss required only for long BUY\")\n+    if inputs.stop_loss is None:\n+        return _rule(R1, RuleOutcome.VIOLATED, \"stop-loss is missing for a long BUY\")\n+    if not _is_finite(inputs.stop_loss):\n+        return _rule(R1, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, \"stop-loss is not finite\")\n+    return _rule(R1, RuleOutcome.PASS, \"stop-loss present\", observed=inputs.stop_loss)\n+\n+\n+def _evaluate_single_name(inputs: RiskInputs, direction, policy: RiskPolicy) -> RuleResult:\n+    \"\"\"R2: projected single-name weight <= cap, and the BUY must increase the position.\n+\n+    UNKNOWN only when the weight is missing/unusable, or when a usable snapshot\n+    shows the buy does not genuinely increase the holding. Affordability and\n+    snapshot consistency are R6's job.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    if direction != \"long\":\n+        return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.NOT_APPLICABLE, \"single-name cap applies to long BUY\")\n+    if inputs.target_position is None:\n+        return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, \"target_position is missing\")\n+    weight = inputs.target_position.target_position_weight\n+    problem = weight_problem(weight)\n+    if problem is not None:\n+        return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, problem)\n+    if weight > policy.single_name_cap:\n+        return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.VIOLATED,\n+                     \"projected single-name weight exceeds the cap\",\n+                     observed=weight, threshold=policy.single_name_cap)\n+    # A genuine BUY must increase the existing position (when the book is usable).\n+    if inputs.portfolio is not None:\n+        try:\n+            validate_snapshot(inputs.portfolio, inputs.trade_date)\n+        except SnapshotError:\n+            # Snapshot integrity is R6's concern; the cap itself already passed.\n+            return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.PASS, \"projected weight within cap\",\n+                         observed=weight, threshold=policy.single_name_cap)\n+        current = current_stock_value(inputs.portfolio, inputs.ticker)\n+        projected = projected_stock_value(weight, inputs.portfolio.portfolio_value)\n+        if projected - current <= 0.0:\n+            return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN,\n+                         \"BUY does not increase the existing position (not a genuine buy)\",\n+                         observed=projected - current)\n+    return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.PASS, \"projected weight within cap\",\n+                 observed=weight, threshold=policy.single_name_cap)\n+\n+\n+def _evaluate_sector(inputs: RiskInputs, direction, policy: RiskPolicy) -> RuleResult:\n+    \"\"\"R3: projected affected-sector exposure <= cap.\n+\n+    UNKNOWN when the target position/portfolio is missing, the weight or snapshot\n+    is unusable, the target sector is unknown, or any holding lacks a sector.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    if direction != \"long\":\n+        return _rule(R3, RuleOutcome.NOT_APPLICABLE, \"sector cap applies to long BUY\")\n+    if inputs.target_position is None or inputs.portfolio is None:\n+        return _rule(R3, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, \"target_position or portfolio snapshot is missing\")\n+    weight = inputs.target_position.target_position_weight\n+    if weight_problem(weight) is not None:\n+        return _rule(R3, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, \"target weight is unusable\")\n+    try:\n+        validate_snapshot(inputs.portfolio, inputs.trade_date)\n+    except SnapshotError as exc:\n+        return _rule(R3, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, f\"portfolio snapshot unusable: {exc}\")\n+    # An unclassified holding makes the book's sector exposure unknowable.\n+    if any(h.sector is None for h in inputs.portfolio.holdings):\n+        return _rule(R3, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, \"a holding has no sector classification\")\n+    sector = target_sector(inputs.portfolio, inputs.ticker, inputs.target_position.sector)\n+    if sector is None:\n+        return _rule(R3, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, \"target sector is unknown\")\n+    projected_value = projected_sector_exposure(inputs.portfolio, inputs.ticker, sector, weight)\n+    if not _is_finite(projected_value):\n+        return _rule(R3, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, \"projected sector exposure is not finite\")\n+    exposure = projected_value / inputs.portfolio.portfolio_value\n+    if exposure > policy.sector_cap + 1e-12:\n+        return _rule(R3, RuleOutcome.VIOLATED,\n+                     \"projected sector exposure exceeds the cap\",\n+                     observed=exposure, threshold=policy.sector_cap)\n+    return _rule(R3, RuleOutcome.PASS, \"projected sector exposure within cap\",\n+                 observed=exposure, threshold=policy.sector_cap)\n+\n+\n+def _evaluate_reward_risk(inputs: RiskInputs, direction) -> RuleResult:\n+    \"\"\"R4: reward-to-risk >= min and stop < entry < target (direction-aware).\"\"\"\n+    if direction == \"hold\":\n+        return _rule(R4, RuleOutcome.NOT_APPLICABLE, \"reward-to-risk applies to a trade, not HOLD\")\n+    if direction is None:\n+        return _rule(R4, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, \"direction is ambiguous\")\n+    if inputs.entry_price is None or inputs.stop_loss is None or inputs.price_target is None:\n+        return _rule(R4, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, \"entry, stop, or target is missing\")\n+    if not _is_finite(inputs.entry_price) or not _is_finite(inputs.stop_loss) \\\n+            or not _is_finite(inputs.price_target):\n+        return _rule(R4, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, \"a price field is not finite\")\n+    entry, stop, target = inputs.entry_price, inputs.stop_loss, inputs.price_target\n+    if direction == \"long\":\n+        if not (stop < entry < target):\n+            return _rule(R4, RuleOutcome.VIOLATED,\n+                         \"long ordering must be stop < entry < target\")\n+        risk = entry - stop\n+        reward = target - entry\n+    else:  # short (risk-reducing direction), pending team confirmation\n+        if not (stop > entry > target):\n+            return _rule(R4, RuleOutcome.VIOLATED,\n+                         \"short ordering must be target < entry < stop\")\n+        risk = stop - entry\n+        reward = entry - target\n+    if risk <= 0.0:\n+        return _rule(R4, RuleOutcome.VIOLATED, \"risk per unit is not positive\")\n+    # Threshold comes from the policy applied by the caller; default is used here.\n+    ratio = reward / risk\n+    return _rule(R4, RuleOutcome.PASS, \"reward-to-risk computable\", observed=ratio)\n+\n+\n+def _apply_reward_threshold(rule: RuleResult, policy: RiskPolicy) -> RuleResult:\n+    \"\"\"Turn R4's PASS into VIOLATED when the computed ratio is below the floor.\"\"\"\n+    if rule.outcome != RuleOutcome.PASS or rule.observed is None:\n+        return rule\n+    if rule.observed + 1e-12 < policy.min_reward_risk:\n+        return RuleResult(rule_id=rule.rule_id, outcome=RuleOutcome.VIOLATED,\n+                          detail=\"reward-to-risk is below the floor\",\n+                          observed=rule.observed, threshold=policy.min_reward_risk)\n+    return RuleResult(rule_id=rule.rule_id, outcome=RuleOutcome.PASS,\n+                      detail=rule.detail, observed=rule.observed,\n+                      threshold=policy.min_reward_risk)\n+\n+\n+def _evaluate_blacklist(inputs: RiskInputs, policy: RiskPolicy) -> RuleResult:\n+    \"\"\"R5: the analyzed ticker must not be blacklisted.\"\"\"\n+    if policy.is_blacklisted(inputs.ticker):\n+        return _rule(R5, RuleOutcome.VIOLATED, \"ticker is on the blacklist\")\n+    return _rule(R5, RuleOutcome.PASS, \"ticker is not blacklisted\")\n+\n+\n+def _snapshot(inputs: RiskInputs) -> dict:\n+    \"\"\"A minimal, redacted input snapshot for the audit record.\"\"\"\n+    tp = inputs.target_position\n+    pf = inputs.portfolio\n+    return {\n+        \"ticker\": inputs.ticker,\n+        \"trade_date\": inputs.trade_date,\n+        \"action\": inputs.action,\n+        \"model_rating\": inputs.model_rating,\n+        \"entry_price\": inputs.entry_price,\n+        \"stop_loss\": inputs.stop_loss,\n+        \"price_target\": inputs.price_target,\n+        \"target_position_weight\": tp.target_position_weight if tp else None,\n+        \"target_sector\": tp.sector if tp else None,\n+        \"portfolio_value\": pf.portfolio_value if pf else None,\n+        \"cash\": pf.cash if pf else None,\n+        \"holdings_count\": len(pf.holdings) if pf else 0,\n+        \"valuation_date\": pf.valuation_date if pf else None,\n+    }\n+\n+\n+def _decide(rule_results: list[RuleResult], direction) -> tuple[RiskVerdict, DecisionStatus]:\n+    \"\"\"Aggregate per-rule outcomes into a verdict and delivery status.\"\"\"\n+    outcomes = {r.rule_id: r.outcome for r in rule_results}\n+    violated = any(o == RuleOutcome.VIOLATED for o in outcomes.values())\n+    unknown = any(o == RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN for o in outcomes.values())\n+\n+    if violated:\n+        verdict = RiskVerdict.REJECTED\n+    elif unknown:\n+        verdict = RiskVerdict.NEEDS_REVIEW\n+    else:\n+        verdict = RiskVerdict.APPROVED\n+\n+    if verdict == RiskVerdict.REJECTED:\n+        status = DecisionStatus.BLOCKED\n+    elif verdict == RiskVerdict.NEEDS_REVIEW:\n+        status = DecisionStatus.PENDING_REVIEW\n+    elif direction == \"hold\":\n+        status = DecisionStatus.NO_TRADE\n+    else:\n+        status = DecisionStatus.ACTIONABLE\n+    return verdict, status\n+\n+\n+def _direction_is_enforceable(direction, consistent: bool) -> bool:\n+    \"\"\"Whether an actionable (long/short) trade is well-defined enough to be actionable.\"\"\"\n+    return consistent and direction in (\"long\", \"short\")\n+\n+\n+def evaluate_risk(inputs: RiskInputs, policy: RiskPolicy | None = None) -> RiskEvaluation:\n+    \"\"\"Evaluate one decision against the policy; return a complete, audited result.\"\"\"\n+    policy = policy or RiskPolicy()\n+    started_wall = datetime.now(UTC)\n+    started = time.perf_counter()\n+    direction, consistent = _direction(inputs.action, inputs.model_rating)\n+\n+    rule_results: list[RuleResult] = []\n+    rule_results.append(_evaluate_stop_loss(inputs, direction))\n+    rule_results.append(_evaluate_single_name(inputs, direction, policy))\n+    rule_results.append(_evaluate_sector(inputs, direction, policy))\n+    rule_results.append(_apply_reward_threshold(_evaluate_reward_risk(inputs, direction), policy))\n+    rule_results.append(_evaluate_blacklist(inputs, policy))\n+    rule_results.append(_evaluate_integrity(inputs, direction, consistent))\n+\n+    # A positive marker when every rule passes, so every verdict carries an id.\n+    all_pass = all(r.outcome in (RuleOutcome.PASS, RuleOutcome.NOT_APPLICABLE)\n+                   for r in rule_results)\n+    if all_pass:\n+        rule_results.append(_rule(R0, RuleOutcome.PASS, \"all applicable rules passed\"))\n+\n+    verdict, status = _decide(rule_results, direction)\n+\n+    # Safety: an approved but not-enforceable direction (ambiguous/inconsistent,\n+    # unsupported SELL) must never be ACTIONABLE. R6 already makes these UNKNOWN ->\n+    # NEEDS_REVIEW; this is a defensive second guard.\n+    if verdict == RiskVerdict.APPROVED and direction in (\"long\", \"short\") \\\n+            and not _direction_is_enforceable(direction, consistent):\n+        verdict, status = RiskVerdict.NEEDS_REVIEW, DecisionStatus.PENDING_REVIEW\n+\n+    evaluated_rule_ids = [r.rule_id for r in rule_results]\n+    triggered = [r.rule_id for r in rule_results if r.outcome == RuleOutcome.VIOLATED]\n+\n+    latency_ms = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000.0\n+\n+    return RiskEvaluation(\n+        verdict=verdict,\n+        decision_status=status,\n+        model_rating=inputs.model_rating,\n+        evaluated_rule_ids=evaluated_rule_ids,\n+        triggered_violation_ids=triggered,\n+        rule_results=rule_results,\n+        policy_version=policy.version,\n+        policy_hash=policy.policy_hash,\n+        input_snapshot=_snapshot(inputs),\n+        evaluated_at_utc=started_wall.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f\") + \"Z\",\n+        latency_ms=latency_ms,\n+    )\n+\n+\n+def audit_id_for(evaluation: RiskEvaluation) -> str:\n+    \"\"\"A deterministic audit id from the evaluation's content and result.\"\"\"\n+    basis = (\n+        evaluation.policy_hash\n+        + \"|\" + evaluation.evaluated_at_utc\n+        + \"|\" + str(evaluation.verdict)\n+        + \"|\" + evaluation.input_snapshot.get(\"ticker\", \"\")\n+        + \"|\" + evaluation.input_snapshot.get(\"trade_date\", \"\")\n+    )\n+    return hashlib.sha256(basis.encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()\n",

        "file": "tradingagents/risk_gate/models.py",
        "patch": "Index: tradingagents/risk_gate/models.py\n===================================================================\n--- tradingagents/risk_gate/models.py\t\n+++ tradingagents/risk_gate/models.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,160 @@\n+\"\"\"Pydantic models for the FR-A1 deterministic risk gate.\n+\n+The engine's contract: structured inputs (``RiskInputs`` and its parts), structured\n+outputs (``RuleResult``, ``RiskEvaluation``, ``RiskAuditRecord``), and the enums\n+that keep the model rating, the risk verdict, and the delivery status distinct.\n+\n+This module is pure data: no network, file I/O, LLM, or LangGraph import. Validation\n+is strict about finiteness (``allow_inf_nan=False``) so a malformed numeric cannot\n+sneak through as a usable value; the values that matter to the rules are also\n+checked for finiteness at evaluation time and degrade to ``UNKNOWN`` when unusable.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+from enum import StrEnum\n+\n+from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field\n+\n+\n+class RiskVerdict(StrEnum):\n+    \"\"\"The gate's independent judgment about a decision.\"\"\"\n+\n+    APPROVED = \"APPROVED\"\n+    REJECTED = \"REJECTED\"\n+    NEEDS_REVIEW = \"NEEDS_REVIEW\"\n+\n+\n+class DecisionStatus(StrEnum):\n+    \"\"\"What the rest of the system may do with the decision.\"\"\"\n+\n+    ACTIONABLE = \"ACTIONABLE\"\n+    BLOCKED = \"BLOCKED\"\n+    PENDING_REVIEW = \"PENDING_REVIEW\"\n+    NO_TRADE = \"NO_TRADE\"\n+\n+\n+class RuleOutcome(StrEnum):\n+    \"\"\"Per-rule result. ``UNKNOWN`` (insufficient input) is not ``VIOLATED``.\"\"\"\n+\n+    PASS = \"PASS\"\n+    VIOLATED = \"VIOLATED\"\n+    NOT_APPLICABLE = \"NOT_APPLICABLE\"\n+    UNKNOWN = \"UNKNOWN\"\n+\n+\n+class RuleResult(BaseModel):\n+    \"\"\"One rule's outcome, with the numbers that produced it (audit).\"\"\"\n+\n+    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True)\n+\n+    rule_id: str\n+    outcome: RuleOutcome\n+    detail: str = \"\"\n+    observed: float | None = None\n+    threshold: float | None = None\n+\n+\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+# Inputs\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+\n+\n+class TargetPosition(BaseModel):\n+    \"\"\"The projected post-trade single-name exposure.\n+\n+    ``target_position_weight`` is the projected weight of the analyzed instrument\n+    as a fraction of total portfolio value. ``sector`` names the instrument's\n+    sector and is required when the instrument is not already held. Values are not\n+    coerced; a non-finite or out-of-range weight is treated as unusable (UNKNOWN),\n+    never as an approval.\n+    \"\"\"\n+\n+    model_config = ConfigDict(allow_inf_nan=False)\n+\n+    target_position_weight: float | None = None\n+    sector: str | None = None\n+\n+\n+class Holding(BaseModel):\n+    \"\"\"A current portfolio holding, by current market value (never average cost).\"\"\"\n+\n+    model_config = ConfigDict(allow_inf_nan=False)\n+\n+    ticker: str\n+    market_value: float\n+    sector: str | None = None\n+\n+\n+class PortfolioRiskSnapshot(BaseModel):\n+    \"\"\"A minimal, internally consistent snapshot of the caller's book.\n+\n+    Cash-funded long assumption (v1): the trade is paid from ``cash``.\n+    Consistency: ``cash + sum(holdings.market_value) == portfolio_value`` within a\n+    small tolerance; an inconsistent snapshot is not usable for exposure rules.\n+    \"\"\"\n+\n+    model_config = ConfigDict(allow_inf_nan=False)\n+\n+    valuation_date: str\n+    portfolio_value: float\n+    cash: float\n+    holdings: list[Holding] = Field(default_factory=list)\n+\n+\n+class RiskInputs(BaseModel):\n+    \"\"\"Everything the gate evaluates, assembled by the caller from structured data.\n+\n+    The analyzed ticker, the decision fields, and the caller's book. ``action`` and\n+    ``model_rating`` are the model's own outputs; a contradiction between them is\n+    ambiguous and cannot be approved.\n+\n+    Numeric decision fields allow ``inf``/``nan`` at the model layer so a malformed\n+    value is representable; the engine then records it as UNKNOWN (NEEDS_REVIEW)\n+    rather than letting it validate into an usable number. It must never become an\n+    approval.\n+    \"\"\"\n+\n+    model_config = ConfigDict(allow_inf_nan=True)\n+\n+    ticker: str\n+    trade_date: str\n+    action: str | None = None\n+    entry_price: float | None = None\n+    stop_loss: float | None = None\n+    price_target: float | None = None\n+    model_rating: str | None = None\n+    target_position: TargetPosition | None = None\n+    portfolio: PortfolioRiskSnapshot | None = None\n+\n+\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+# Outputs\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+\n+\n+class RiskEvaluation(BaseModel):\n+    \"\"\"The gate's complete, auditable result for one decision.\"\"\"\n+\n+    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True)\n+\n+    verdict: RiskVerdict\n+    decision_status: DecisionStatus\n+    model_rating: str | None\n+    evaluated_rule_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)\n+    triggered_violation_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)\n+    rule_results: list[RuleResult] = Field(default_factory=list)\n+    policy_version: str\n+    policy_hash: str\n+    input_snapshot: dict\n+    evaluated_at_utc: str\n+    latency_ms: float\n+\n+\n+class RiskAuditRecord(BaseModel):\n+    \"\"\"An audit envelope around one evaluation.\"\"\"\n+\n+    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True)\n+\n+    audit_id: str\n+    evaluation: RiskEvaluation\n",
        "additions": 160,
        "deletions": 0,
        "status": "added"
      },

        "file": "tradingagents/risk_gate/policy.py",
        "patch": "Index: tradingagents/risk_gate/policy.py\n===================================================================\n--- tradingagents/risk_gate/policy.py\t\n+++ tradingagents/risk_gate/policy.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,74 @@\n+\"\"\"Versioned risk policy and its stable hash (FR-A1 §5.5).\n+\n+The policy is code-defined constants, not runtime configuration (that is FR-A3).\n+``policy_hash`` is a SHA-256 over a canonical serialization of the *effective*\n+policy values, so changing any threshold — or the blacklist — changes the hash even\n+if ``version`` was not bumped. The hash is stable for equal policies.\n+\n+Pure data: no network, file I/O, LLM, or LangGraph import.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+import hashlib\n+import json\n+from dataclasses import dataclass, field\n+\n+from tradingagents.dataflows.symbols import normalize_symbol\n+\n+DEFAULT_VERSION = \"fr-a1-v1\"\n+\n+# Draft thresholds (FR-A1). Inclusive on the allowed side.\n+DEFAULT_SINGLE_NAME_CAP = 0.10\n+DEFAULT_SECTOR_CAP = 0.30\n+DEFAULT_MIN_REWARD_RISK = 1.5\n+\n+\n+def normalize_blacklist(tickers) -> frozenset[str]:\n+    \"\"\"Canonical, order-independent blacklist set (normalized symbols).\"\"\"\n+    return frozenset(normalize_symbol(t) for t in tickers if isinstance(t, str) and t.strip())\n+\n+\n+def _canonical(payload: dict) -> str:\n+    return json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(\",\", \":\"), ensure_ascii=True)\n+\n+\n+@dataclass(frozen=True)\n+class RiskPolicy:\n+    \"\"\"Immutable risk policy. Construct with overrides; the hash follows the values.\n+\n+    ``blacklist`` accepts any iterable of tickers and is normalized on construction,\n+    so ``RiskPolicy(blacklist={\"aapl\"})`` and ``RiskPolicy(blacklist={\"AAPL\"})`` are\n+    equal and share a hash.\n+    \"\"\"\n+\n+    version: str = DEFAULT_VERSION\n+    single_name_cap: float = DEFAULT_SINGLE_NAME_CAP\n+    sector_cap: float = DEFAULT_SECTOR_CAP\n+    min_reward_risk: float = DEFAULT_MIN_REWARD_RISK\n+    blacklist: frozenset[str] = field(default_factory=frozenset)\n+\n+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:\n+        # Normalize the blacklist in-place on the frozen dataclass.\n+        object.__setattr__(self, \"blacklist\", normalize_blacklist(self.blacklist))\n+\n+    def _hash_payload(self) -> dict:\n+        return {\n+            \"version\": self.version,\n+            \"single_name_cap\": float(self.single_name_cap),\n+            \"sector_cap\": float(self.sector_cap),\n+            \"min_reward_risk\": float(self.min_reward_risk),\n+            \"blacklist\": sorted(self.blacklist),\n+        }\n+\n+    @property\n+    def policy_hash(self) -> str:\n+        \"\"\"Stable SHA-256 over the effective policy values.\"\"\"\n+        return hashlib.sha256(_canonical(self._hash_payload()).encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()\n+\n+    def is_blacklisted(self, ticker: str) -> bool:\n+        \"\"\"Whether ``ticker`` is on the blacklist under canonical normalization.\"\"\"\n+        return normalize_symbol(ticker) in self.blacklist\n+\n+\n+DEFAULT_POLICY = RiskPolicy()\n",
        "additions": 74,
        "deletions": 0,
        "status": "added"
      },

        "file": "tradingagents/risk_gate/portfolio_snapshot.py",
        "patch": "Index: tradingagents/risk_gate/portfolio_snapshot.py\n===================================================================\n--- tradingagents/risk_gate/portfolio_snapshot.py\t\n+++ tradingagents/risk_gate/portfolio_snapshot.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,110 @@\n+\"\"\"Portfolio snapshot consistency and projected exposure (FR-A1 §5.3).\n+\n+Under the documented cash-funded long assumption:\n+\n+    projected_stock_value  = target_weight * portfolio_value\n+    projected_sector_value = current_sector_value - current_stock_value\n+                             + projected_stock_value\n+\n+Exposure uses current **market values**, never average cost. This module returns\n+``None`` (with a reason) whenever the snapshot cannot be trusted, so the caller can\n+record ``UNKNOWN`` rather than invent a value.\n+\n+Pure arithmetic: no network, file I/O, LLM, or LangGraph import.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+import math\n+\n+from tradingagents.dataflows.symbols import normalize_symbol\n+\n+from .models import PortfolioRiskSnapshot\n+from .sizing import projected_stock_value\n+\n+# Currency-scale tolerance for the book identity; market values are floats.\n+_CONSISTENCY_TOLERANCE = 1.0  # one unit of the quote currency\n+\n+\n+class SnapshotError(Exception):\n+    \"\"\"A snapshot that cannot be used: missing parts, inconsistent, or stale.\"\"\"\n+\n+\n+def _finite(*values: float) -> bool:\n+    return all(isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool) and math.isfinite(v)\n+               for v in values)\n+\n+\n+def validate_snapshot(snapshot: PortfolioRiskSnapshot | None, trade_date: str) -> None:\n+    \"\"\"Raise :class:`SnapshotError` when the snapshot is not usable.\n+\n+    Checks presence, finiteness, the book identity\n+    ``cash + sum(market_value) == portfolio_value``, and that the valuation date\n+    matches the run's trade date.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    if snapshot is None:\n+        raise SnapshotError(\"portfolio risk snapshot is missing\")\n+    if not snapshot.valuation_date:\n+        raise SnapshotError(\"valuation_date is missing\")\n+    if snapshot.valuation_date != trade_date:\n+        raise SnapshotError(\n+            f\"valuation_date {snapshot.valuation_date!r} does not match trade_date {trade_date!r}\"\n+        )\n+    if not _finite(snapshot.portfolio_value, snapshot.cash):\n+        raise SnapshotError(\"portfolio_value or cash is not finite\")\n+    if snapshot.portfolio_value <= 0.0:\n+        raise SnapshotError(\"portfolio_value must be positive\")\n+    for h in snapshot.holdings:\n+        if not _finite(h.market_value):\n+            raise SnapshotError(f\"holding {h.ticker!r} market_value is not finite\")\n+        if h.market_value < 0.0:\n+            raise SnapshotError(f\"holding {h.ticker!r} market_value is negative\")\n+    total = snapshot.cash + sum(h.market_value for h in snapshot.holdings)\n+    if abs(total - snapshot.portfolio_value) > _CONSISTENCY_TOLERANCE:\n+        raise SnapshotError(\n+            f\"book is inconsistent: cash+holdings={total!r} != portfolio_value=\"\n+            f\"{snapshot.portfolio_value!r}\"\n+        )\n+\n+\n+def current_stock_value(snapshot: PortfolioRiskSnapshot, ticker: str) -> float:\n+    \"\"\"The current market value held in ``ticker`` (0.0 when not held).\"\"\"\n+    symbol = normalize_symbol(ticker)\n+    return sum(h.market_value for h in snapshot.holdings if normalize_symbol(h.ticker) == symbol)\n+\n+\n+def target_sector(snapshot: PortfolioRiskSnapshot, ticker: str, explicit_sector: str | None) -> str | None:\n+    \"\"\"The analyzed instrument's sector, or ``None`` when it cannot be determined.\n+\n+    Prefers the explicit sector from ``target_position``; when the instrument is\n+    already held, its recorded sector is a fallback. Never inferred from prose.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    if explicit_sector:\n+        return explicit_sector\n+    symbol = normalize_symbol(ticker)\n+    for h in snapshot.holdings:\n+        if normalize_symbol(h.ticker) == symbol and h.sector:\n+            return h.sector\n+    return None\n+\n+\n+def current_sector_value(snapshot: PortfolioRiskSnapshot, sector: str) -> float:\n+    \"\"\"Sum of market values currently held in ``sector``.\"\"\"\n+    return sum(h.market_value for h in snapshot.holdings if h.sector == sector)\n+\n+\n+def projected_sector_exposure(\n+    snapshot: PortfolioRiskSnapshot,\n+    ticker: str,\n+    sector: str,\n+    target_weight: float,\n+) -> float:\n+    \"\"\"Projected post-trade sector exposure after a cash-funded buy to ``target_weight``.\n+\n+    ``current_sector_value - current_stock_value + projected_stock_value``. The\n+    result is a *value*, not a fraction; the caller divides by ``portfolio_value``.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    current_stock = current_stock_value(snapshot, ticker)\n+    current_sector = current_sector_value(snapshot, sector)\n+    projected_stock = projected_stock_value(target_weight, snapshot.portfolio_value)\n+    return current_sector - current_stock + projected_stock\n",
        "additions": 110,
        "deletions": 0,
        "status": "added"

        "file": "tradingagents/risk_gate/sizing.py",
        "patch": "Index: tradingagents/risk_gate/sizing.py\n===================================================================\n--- tradingagents/risk_gate/sizing.py\t\n+++ tradingagents/risk_gate/sizing.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@\n+\"\"\"Projected single-name weight validation (FR-A1 §5.3).\n+\n+The caller supplies ``target_position_weight`` explicitly; the gate never infers a\n+position from free-text sizing. This module decides whether a supplied weight is\n+usable and derives the projected market value from it under the cash-funded long\n+assumption.\n+\n+Pure arithmetic: no network, file I/O, LLM, or LangGraph import.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+import math\n+\n+\n+def weight_problem(weight: float | None) -> str | None:\n+    \"\"\"Return why ``weight`` is unusable, or ``None`` when it is a valid fraction.\n+\n+    A usable weight is a finite number in the closed interval [0, 1]. Anything\n+    else (missing, NaN/inf, negative, above 1) is unusable and must not become an\n+    approval.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    if weight is None:\n+        return \"target_position_weight is missing\"\n+    if not isinstance(weight, (int, float)) or isinstance(weight, bool):\n+        return \"target_position_weight is not numeric\"\n+    if isinstance(weight, float) and not math.isfinite(weight):\n+        return \"target_position_weight is not finite\"\n+    if weight < 0.0:\n+        return \"target_position_weight is negative\"\n+    if weight > 1.0:\n+        return \"target_position_weight exceeds 100%\"\n+    return None\n+\n+\n+def projected_stock_value(weight: float, portfolio_value: float) -> float:\n+    \"\"\"The projected post-trade value of the analyzed instrument (cash-funded).\"\"\"\n+    return weight * portfolio_value\n",

1: """Exact threshold boundaries for the risk gate (FR-A1).
2: 
3: Thresholds are the draft 10% / 30% / 1.5. Boundary values on the allowed side
4: must PASS; values just beyond must be rejected. Sector tests verify **projected
5: post-trade** exposure under the documented cash-funded assumption, not merely the
6: current holdings.
7: """
8: 
9: from __future__ import annotations
10: 
11: import pytest
12: 
13: from tests.risk_gate._support import (
14:     R2,
15:     R3,
16:     R4,
17:     evaluate,
18:     make_buy,
19:     make_target,
20:     violated_ids,
21: )
22: 
23: # A fixed book for sector tests: portfolio 1,000,000, MSFT 150,000 technology,
24: # and a non-technology holding filling the rest. The target stock is AAPL,
25: # currently unheld, so projected Technology = MSFT + projected AAPL value.
26: _BOOK_BASE = 1_000_000.0
27: 
28: 
29: def _sector_book(projected_tech_total):
30:     """Build a cash-funded book where, after buying AAPL at weight 0.05
31:     (50,000), Technology equals ``projected_tech_total``.
32: 
33:     AAPL is unheld (0); MSFT carries the rest of Technology. Cash funds the
34:     AAPL purchase (>= 50,000) and Financials fill the remainder, so the book
35:     sums to portfolio_value and the purchase is affordable.
36:     """
37:     aapl_projected = 0.05 * _BOOK_BASE  # 50,000
38:     msft = projected_tech_total - aapl_projected
39:     cash = 60_000.0  # enough to fund the 50,000 purchase
40:     financials = _BOOK_BASE - (msft + cash)
41:     return {
42:         "valuation_date": "2026-01-09",
43:         "portfolio_value": _BOOK_BASE,
44:         "cash": cash,
45:         "holdings": [
46:             {"ticker": "AAPL", "market_value": 0.0, "sector": "Technology"},
47:             {"ticker": "MSFT", "market_value": msft, "sector": "Technology"},
48:             {"ticker": "JPM", "market_value": financials, "sector": "Financials"},
49:         ],
50:     }
51: 
52: 
53: @pytest.mark.unit
54: @pytest.mark.parametrize(
55:     "weight, approved",
56:     [
57:         # VALID_BUY holds AAPL 20,000, so a target weight whose projected value
58:         # does not increase the position is not a genuine BUY and is not approved.
59:         (0.0, False),          # projected 0 < held 20,000 -> reduces, not approved
60:         (0.02, False),         # projected 20,000 == held 20,000 -> no increase
61:         (0.021, True),         # projected 21,000 > 20,000 -> genuine increase
62:         (0.099, True),
63:         (0.10, True),          # cap is inclusive
64:         (0.1000001, False),    # over the cap
65:         (0.11, False),
66:     ],
67:     ids=["zero_reduces", "no_increase", "just_increase", "below", "exactly_10pct",
68:          "just_over", "over"],
69: )
70: def test_single_name_cap_boundary(weight, approved):
71:     """FR-A1: single-name cap is inclusive at 10% and a BUY must increase the holding."""
72:     result = evaluate(make_buy(target_position=make_target(weight)))
73:     assert (result.verdict == "APPROVED") is approved
74:     if not approved and weight > 0.10:
75:         assert R2 in violated_ids(result)
76: 
77: 
78: @pytest.mark.unit
79: @pytest.mark.parametrize(
80:     "projected_tech_total, approved",
81:     [
82:         (250_000.0, True),    # 25%
83:         (299_999.0, True),    # just below
84:         (300_000.0, True),    # exactly 30% (inclusive)
85:         (300_001.0, False),   # just over
86:         (350_000.0, False),   # 35%
87:     ],
88:     ids=["below", "just_below", "exactly_30pct", "just_over", "over"],
89: )
90: def test_sector_cap_boundary(projected_tech_total, approved):
91:     """FR-A1: sector cap is inclusive at 30% on projected post-trade exposure."""
92:     data = make_buy(portfolio=_sector_book(projected_tech_total))
93:     result = evaluate(data)
94:     assert (result.verdict == "APPROVED") is approved
95:     if not approved:
96:         assert R3 in violated_ids(result)
97: 
98: 
99: @pytest.mark.unit
100: @pytest.mark.parametrize(
101:     "target, approved",

1: """INV-A1 invariants and boundary enforcement of the risk gate (FR-A1).
2: 
3: Bulk deterministic sweep: no APPROVED verdict may lack a stop-loss for an
4: actionable BUY, exceed the single-name cap, or claim ACTIONABLE while blocked.
5: """
6: 
7: from __future__ import annotations
8:

10:

18:     """INV-A1: an actionable BUY is never APPROVED without a stop-loss."""
19:     for stop in (None, 90.0, 101.0):
20:         result = evaluate(make_buy(stop_loss=stop))
21:         if result.verdict == "APPROVED" and result.decision_status == "ACTIONABLE":
22:             assert stop is not None
23:     # The concrete violation case must not be approved at all.
24:     assert evaluate(make_buy(stop_loss=None)).verdict != "APPROVED"
25:

28: def test_invariant_no_approval_over_single_name_cap():
29:     """INV-A1: an APPROVED decision never exceeds the 10% single-name cap."""
30:     for weight in (0.0, 0.05, 0.10, 0.11, 0.25):

        "text": "\"\"\"INV-A1 invariants and boundary enforcement of the risk gate (FR-A1).\n\nBulk deterministic sweep: no APPROVED verdict may lack a stop-loss for an\nactionable BUY, exceed the single-name cap, or claim ACTIONABLE while blocked.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport itertools\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom tests.risk_gate._support import evaluate, make_buy, make_target\n\n\n@pytest.mark.unit\ndef test_invariant_no_approval_without_stop_loss():\n    \"\"\"INV-A1: an actionable BUY is never APPROVED without a stop-loss.\"\"\"\n    for stop in (None, 90.0, 101.0):\n        result = evaluate(make_buy(stop_loss=stop))\n        if result.verdict == \"APPROVED\" and result.decision_status == \"ACTIONABLE\":\n            assert stop is not None\n    # The concrete violation case must not be approved at all.\n    assert evaluate(make_buy(stop_loss=None)).verdict != \"APPROVED\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.unit\ndef test_invariant_no_approval_over_single_name_cap():\n    \"\"\"INV-A1: an APPROVED decision never exceeds the 10% single-name cap.\"\"\"\n    for weight in (0.0, 0.05, 0.10, 0.11, 0.25):\n        result = evaluate(make_buy(target_position=make_target(weight)))\n        if result.verdict == \"APPROVED\":\n            assert weight <= 0.10\n\n\n@pytest.mark.unit\ndef test_invariant_approved_implies_actionable_or_no_trade():\n    \"\"\"FR-A1 §5.2: APPROVED maps only to ACTIONABLE or NO_TRADE.\"\"\"\n    result = evaluate(make_buy())\n    if result.verdict == \"APPROVED\":\n        assert result.decision_status in (\"ACTIONABLE\", \"NO_TRADE\")\n\n\n@pytest.mark.unit\ndef test_invariant_sweep_never_approves_violations():\n    \"\"\"INV-A1: sweep over invalid cases; zero approvals of any violating case.\"\"\"\n    stops = [None, 105.0, 90.0]\n    targets = [95.0, 105.0, 130.0]\n    weights = [0.05, 0.12]\n\n    def violates(stop, target, weight):\n        if stop is None or stop >= 100.0:\n            return True\n        if target <= stop or target <= 100.0:\n            return True\n        return weight > 0.10\n\n    for stop, target, weight in itertools.product(stops, targets, weights):\n        result = evaluate(\n            make_buy(stop_loss=stop, price_target=target,\n                     target_position=make_target(weight))\n        )\n        if violates(stop, target, weight):\n            assert result.verdict != \"APPROVED\", (stop, target, weight)",

2: 
3: The pure risk engine must add no perceptible latency (p95 ≤ 2 s) and must not
4: depend on network, file I/O, or an LLM. The runtime socket guard from the
5: repository conftest is already active; this module additionally installs its own
6: guard for the duration of the latency loop and performs a structural check that
7: the engine package does not import network/LLM client modules.
8: 
9: The measured p95 is printed in the assertion message so the number is reported,
10: and the core evaluation latency is distinguished from any integration overhead.
11: """
12: 
13: from __future__ import annotations
14: 
15: import socket
16: import subprocess
17: import sys
18: import textwrap
19: import time
20: 
21: import pytest
22: 
23: from tests.risk_gate._support import evaluate, make_buy
24: 
25: 
26: @pytest.mark.unit
27: def test_p95_core_evaluation_latency_within_two_seconds(capsys):
28:     """NFR-A1: core-evaluation p95 ≤ 2000 ms over 1000 evaluations (measured)."""
29:     samples = []
30:     for _ in range(1000):
31:         start = time.perf_counter()
32:         evaluate(make_buy())
33:         samples.append((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000.0)
34:     samples.sort()
35:     p95 = samples[int(0.95 * (len(samples) - 1))]
36:     p50 = samples[len(samples) // 2]
37:     print(f"\ncore evaluation latency: p50={p50:.4f}ms p95={p95:.4f}ms n={len(samples)}")
38:     assert p95 <= 2000.0, f"core p95={p95:.4f}ms exceeds 2000ms"
39: 
40:

42: def test_evaluation_runs_under_a_runtime_socket_guard(monkeypatch):
43:     """NFR-A1: evaluation completes while every socket call refuses to connect."""
44:     def refuse(*a, **k):
45:         raise AssertionError("risk gate attempted a network call")
46: 
47:     monkeypatch.setattr(socket.socket, "connect", refuse)
48:     monkeypatch.setattr(socket.socket, "connect_ex", refuse)
49:     monkeypatch.setattr(socket, "getaddrinfo", refuse)
50:     result = evaluate(make_buy())
51:     assert result.verdict in ("APPROVED", "REJECTED", "NEEDS_REVIEW")
52:

def _normalize_crypto(s: str) -> str | None:
    """Return ``<BASE>-USD`` for a known USD/USDT/USDC-quoted crypto, else None."""
    base = crypto_base(s)
    return f"{base}-USD" if base else None


def normalize_symbol(raw: str) -> str:
    """Map a user/broker symbol to its canonical Yahoo Finance symbol.

    Resolution order (first match wins):
      1. Explicit alias table (metals, energy, index CFDs).
      2. Crypto rule: a known crypto base quoted in USD/USDT/USDC (dashed or
         not) -> ``BASE-USD``.
      3. Forex rule: six letters that are two ISO currency codes -> ``PAIR=X``.
      4. HK rule: a numeric ``.HK`` code -> Yahoo's 4-digit padding
         (``09992.HK`` -> ``9992.HK``, ``700.HK`` -> ``0700.HK``).
      5. Shanghai rule: ``600519.SH`` -> ``600519.SS``.
      6. Otherwise the upper-cased symbol is returned unchanged (plain
         equities, ETFs, Yahoo-native symbols like ``GC=F`` or ``^GSPC``).

    A trailing ``+`` (broker CFD marker, e.g. ``XAUUSD+``) is stripped before
    matching. The function is purely syntactic — it performs no network
    calls — so it is safe to apply on every request.
    """
    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.strip():
        return raw

    s = raw.strip().upper()
    # Broker CFD/qualifier suffixes Yahoo never uses.
    s = s.rstrip("+")

    crypto = _normalize_crypto(s)
    if s in _ALIASES:
        canonical = _ALIASES[s]
    elif crypto is not None:
        canonical = crypto
    elif len(s) == 6 and s[:3] in _FOREX_CURRENCIES and s[3:] in _FOREX_CURRENCIES:
        canonical = f"{s}=X"
    elif hk := _HK_CODE.match(s):
        canonical = f"{int(hk.group(1)):04d}.HK"
    elif sh := _SHANGHAI_SH.match(s):
        canonical = f"{sh.group(1)}.SS"
    else:
        canonical = s

{
  "content": "\"\"\"Pydantic models for the FR-A1 deterministic risk gate.\n\nThe engine's contract: structured inputs (``RiskInputs`` and its parts), structured\noutputs (``RuleResult``, ``RiskEvaluation``, ``RiskAuditRecord``), and the enums\nthat keep the model rating, the risk verdict, and the delivery status distinct.\n\nThis module is pure data: no network, file I/O, LLM, or LangGraph import. Validation\nis strict about finiteness (``allow_inf_nan=False``) so a malformed numeric cannot\nsneak through as a usable value; the values that matter to the rules are also\nchecked for finiteness at evaluation time and degrade to ``UNKNOWN`` when unusable.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom enum import StrEnum\n\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field\n\n\nclass RiskVerdict(StrEnum):\n    \"\"\"The gate's independent judgment about a decision.\"\"\"\n\n    APPROVED = \"APPROVED\"\n    REJECTED = \"REJECTED\"\n    NEEDS_REVIEW = \"NEEDS_REVIEW\"\n\n\nclass DecisionStatus(StrEnum):\n    \"\"\"What the rest of the system may do with the decision.\"\"\"\n\n    ACTIONABLE = \"ACTIONABLE\"\n    BLOCKED = \"BLOCKED\"\n    PENDING_REVIEW = \"PENDING_REVIEW\"\n    NO_TRADE = \"NO_TRADE\"\n\n\nclass RuleOutcome(StrEnum):\n    \"\"\"Per-rule result. ``UNKNOWN`` (insufficient input) is not ``VIOLATED``.\"\"\"\n\n    PASS = \"PASS\"\n    VIOLATED = \"VIOLATED\"\n    NOT_APPLICABLE = \"NOT_APPLICABLE\"\n    UNKNOWN = \"UNKNOWN\"\n\n\nclass RuleResult(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"One rule's outcome, with the numbers that produced it (audit).\"\"\"\n\n    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True)\n\n    rule_id: str\n    outcome: RuleOutcome\n    detail: str = \"\"\n    observed: float | None = None\n    threshold: float | None = None\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Inputs\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\nclass TargetPosition(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"The projected post-trade single-name exposure.\n\n    ``target_position_weight`` is the projected weight of the analyzed instrument\n    as a fraction of total portfolio value. ``sector`` names the instrument's\n    sector and is required when the instrument is not already held. Values are not\n    coerced; a non-finite or out-of-range weight is treated as unusable (UNKNOWN),\n    never as an approval.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    model_config = ConfigDict(allow_inf_nan=False)\n\n    target_position_weight: float | None = None\n    sector: str | None = None\n\n\nclass Holding(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"A current portfolio holding, by current market value (never average cost).\"\"\"\n\n    model_config = ConfigDict(allow_inf_nan=False)\n\n    ticker: str\n    market_value: float\n    sector: str | None = None\n\n\nclass PortfolioRiskSnapshot(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"A minimal, internally consistent snapshot of the caller's book.\n\n    Cash-funded long assumption (v1): the trade is paid from ``cash``.\n    Consistency: ``cash + sum(holdings.market_value) == portfolio_value`` within a\n    small tolerance; an inconsistent snapshot is not usable for exposure rules.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    model_config = ConfigDict(allow_inf_nan=False)\n\n    valuation_date: str\n    portfolio_value: float\n    cash: float\n    holdings: list[Holding] = Field(default_factory=list)\n\n\nclass RiskInputs(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"Everything the gate evaluates, assembled by the caller from structured data.\n\n    The analyzed ticker, the decision fields, and the caller's book. ``action`` and\n    ``model_rating`` are the model's own outputs; a contradiction between them is\n    ambiguous and cannot be approved.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    model_config = ConfigDict(allow_inf_nan=False)\n\n    ticker: str\n    trade_date: str\n    action: str | None = None\n    entry_price: float | None = None\n    stop_loss: float | None = None\n    price_target: float | None = None\n    model_rating: str | None = None\n    target_position: TargetPosition | None = None\n    portfolio: PortfolioRiskSnapshot | None = None\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Outputs\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\nclass RiskEvaluation(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"The gate's complete, auditable result for one decision.\"\"\"\n\n    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True)\n\n    verdict: RiskVerdict\n    decision_status: DecisionStatus\n    model_rating: str | None\n    evaluated_rule_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)\n    triggered_violation_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)\n    rule_results: list[RuleResult] = Field(default_factory=list)\n    policy_version: str\n    policy_hash: str\n    input_snapshot: dict\n    evaluated_at_utc: str\n    latency_ms: float\n\n\nclass RiskAuditRecord(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"An audit envelope around one evaluation.\"\"\"\n\n    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True)\n\n    audit_id: str\n    evaluation: RiskEvaluation\n",

{
  "content": "\"\"\"Versioned risk policy and its stable hash (FR-A1 §5.5).\n\nThe policy is code-defined constants, not runtime configuration (that is FR-A3).\n``policy_hash`` is a SHA-256 over a canonical serialization of the *effective*\npolicy values, so changing any threshold — or the blacklist — changes the hash even\nif ``version`` was not bumped. The hash is stable for equal policies.\n\nPure data: no network, file I/O, LLM, or LangGraph import.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\n\nfrom tradingagents.dataflows.symbols import normalize_symbol\n\nDEFAULT_VERSION = \"fr-a1-v1\"\n\n# Draft thresholds (FR-A1). Inclusive on the allowed side.\nDEFAULT_SINGLE_NAME_CAP = 0.10\nDEFAULT_SECTOR_CAP = 0.30\nDEFAULT_MIN_REWARD_RISK = 1.5\n\n\ndef normalize_blacklist(tickers) -> frozenset[str]:\n    \"\"\"Canonical, order-independent blacklist set (normalized symbols).\"\"\"\n    return frozenset(normalize_symbol(t) for t in tickers if isinstance(t, str) and t.strip())\n\n\ndef _canonical(payload: dict) -> str:\n    return json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(\",\", \":\"), ensure_ascii=True)\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass RiskPolicy:\n    \"\"\"Immutable risk policy. Construct with overrides; the hash follows the values.\n\n    ``blacklist`` accepts any iterable of tickers and is normalized on construction,\n    so ``RiskPolicy(blacklist={\"aapl\"})`` and ``RiskPolicy(blacklist={\"AAPL\"})`` are\n    equal and share a hash.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    version: str = DEFAULT_VERSION\n    single_name_cap: float = DEFAULT_SINGLE_NAME_CAP\n    sector_cap: float = DEFAULT_SECTOR_CAP\n    min_reward_risk: float = DEFAULT_MIN_REWARD_RISK\n    blacklist: frozenset[str] = field(default_factory=frozenset)\n\n    def __post_init__(self) -> None:\n        # Normalize the blacklist in-place on the frozen dataclass.\n        object.__setattr__(self, \"blacklist\", normalize_blacklist(self.blacklist))\n\n    def _hash_payload(self) -> dict:\n        return {\n            \"version\": self.version,\n            \"single_name_cap\": float(self.single_name_cap),\n            \"sector_cap\": float(self.sector_cap),\n            \"min_reward_risk\": float(self.min_reward_risk),\n            \"blacklist\": sorted(self.blacklist),\n        }\n\n    @property\n    def policy_hash(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Stable SHA-256 over the effective policy values.\"\"\"\n        return hashlib.sha256(_canonical(self._hash_payload()).encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()\n\n    def is_blacklisted(self, ticker: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Whether ``ticker`` is on the blacklist under canonical normalization.\"\"\"\n        return normalize_symbol(ticker) in self.blacklist\n\n\nDEFAULT_POLICY = RiskPolicy()\n",

SnapshotError(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A snapshot that cannot be used: missing parts, inconsistent, or stale.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _finite(*values: float) -> bool:\n    return all(isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool) and math.isfinite(v)\n               for v in values)\n\n\ndef validate_snapshot(snapshot: PortfolioRiskSnapshot | None, trade_date: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Raise :class:`SnapshotError` when the snapshot is not usable.\n\n    Checks presence, finiteness, the book identity\n    ``cash + sum(market_value) == portfolio_value``, and that the valuation date\n    matches the run's trade date.\n    \"\"\"\n    if snapshot is None:\n        raise SnapshotError(\"portfolio risk snapshot is missing\")\n    if not snapshot.valuation_date:\n        raise SnapshotError(\"valuation_date is missing\")\n    if snapshot.valuation_date != trade_date:\n        raise SnapshotError(\n            f\"valuation_date {snapshot.valuation_date!r} does not match snapshot.portfolio_value <= 0.0:\n        raise SnapshotError(\"portfolio_value must be positive\")\n    for h in snapshot.holdings:\n        if not _finite(h.market_value):\n            raise Each rule\nis PASS, VIOLATED, NOT_APPLICABLE, or UNKNOWN. UNKNOWN (insufficient input) is\nnot VIOLATED. \"R3_SECTOR_CONCENTRATION\"\nR4 = \"R4_REWARD_RISK\"\nR5 = \"R5_BLACKLIST\"\nR6 = \"R6_INPUT_INTEGRITY\"\n\n# Directions the model may express; anything else is ambiguous.\n_LONG = {\"Buy\",    and not isinstance(value, bool)\n        and math.isfinite(value)\n    )\n\n\ndef _direction(action: str | None, rating: str | None) -> tuple[str | None, bool]:\n    \"\"\"Resolve the decision return _rule(R1, RuleOutcome.VIOLATED, \"stop-loss is missing for a long BUY\")\n    if not _is_finite(inputs.stop_loss):\n        return _rule(R1, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, \"stop-loss is not finite\")\n    return _rule(R1, RuleOutcome.PASS, \"stop-loss present\", observed=inputs.stop_loss)\n\n\ndef _evaluate_single_name(inputs: RiskInputs, direction, policy: RiskPolicy) -> RuleResult:\n    \"\"\"R2: projected single-name weight <= cap, and a genuine increase.\"\"\"\n    if direction != \"long\":\n        return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.NOT_APPLICABLE, \"single-name cap applies to long BUY\")\n    if inputs.target_position is None:\n        return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, \"target_position is missing\")\n    weight = inputs.target_position.target_position_weight\n    problem = weight_problem(weight)\n    if problem is not None:\n        return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, problem)\n    if inputs.portfolio is None:\n        # Without the book we cannot check affordability/increase; the cap itself\n        # is still checkable, but the \"genuine increase\" clause is not.\n        return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, \"portfolio snapshot is required to verify the increase\")\n    try:\n        validate_snapshot(inputs.portfolio, inputs.trade_date)\n    except SnapshotError as exc:\n        return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, f\"portfolio snapshot unusable: {exc}\")\n    if weight > policy.single_name_cap:\n        return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.VIOLATED,\n                     \"projected single-name weight exceeds the cap\",\n                     observed=weight, threshold=policy.single_name_cap)\n    # A genuine BUY must increase the existing position and be affordable from cash.\n    current = current_stock_value(inputs.portfolio, inputs.ticker)\n    projected = projected_stock_value(weight, inputs.portfolio.portfolio_value)\n    increase = projected - current\n    if increase <= 0.0:\n        return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN,\n                     \"BUY does not increase the existing position (not a genuine buy)\",\n                     observed=increase)\n    if increase > inputs.portfolio.cash + 1e-9:\n        return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN,\n                     \"purchase is not affordable from available cash\",\n                     observed=increase, threshold=inputs.portfolio.cash)\n    return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.PASS, \"projected weight within cap and affordable\",\n                 observed=weight, threshold=policy.single_name_cap)\n\n\ndef _evaluate_sector(inputs: RiskInputs, direction, policy: RiskPolicy) -> RuleResult:\n    \"\"\"R3: projected affected-sector exposure <= cap.\"\"\"\n    if direction != \"long\":\n        return _rule(R3, RuleOutcome.NOT_APPLICABLE, \"sector cap applies to long BUY\")\n    if inputs.target_position is None or inputs.portfolio is None:\n        return _rule(R3, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, \"target_position or portfolio snapshot is missing\")\n    weight = inputs.target_position.target_position_weight\n    if weight_problem(weight) is not None:\n        return _rule(R3, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, \"target weight is unusable\")\n    try:\n        validate_snapshot(inputs.portfolio, inputs.trade_date)\n    except SnapshotError as exc:\n        return _rule(R3, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, f\"portfolio snapshot unusable: {exc}\")\n    sector = target_sector(inputs.portfolio, inputs.ticker, inputs.target_position.sector)\n    if sector is None:\n        return _rule(R3, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, \"target sector is unknown\")\n    projected_value = projected_sector_exposure(inputs.portfolio, inputs.ticker, sector, weight)\n    if not _is_finite(projected_value):\n        return _rule(R3, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, \"projected sector exposure is not finite\")\n    exposure = projected_value / inputs.portfolio.portfolio_value\n    if exposure > policy.sector_cap + 1e-12:\n        return _rule(R3, RuleOutcome.VIOLATED,\n                     \"projected sector exposure exceeds the cap\",\n                     observed=exposure, threshold=policy.sector_cap)\n    return _rule(R3, RuleOutcome.PASS, \"projected sector exposure within cap\",\n                 observed=exposure, threshold=policy.sector_cap)\n\n\ndef _evaluate_reward_risk(inputs: RiskInputs, direction) -> RuleResult:\n    \"\"\"R4: reward-to-risk >= min and stop < entry < target (direction-aware).\"\"\"\n    if direction == \"hold\":\n        return _rule(R4, RuleOutcome.NOT_APPLICABLE, \"reward-to-risk applies to a trade, not HOLD\")\n    if direction is None:\n        return _rule(R4, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, \"direction is ambiguous\")\n    if inputs.entry_price is None or inputs.stop_loss is None or inputs.price_target is None:\n        return _rule(R4, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, \"entry, stop, or target is missing\")\n    if not _is_finite(inputs.entry_price) or not _is_finite(inputs.stop_loss) \\\n            or not _is_finite(inputs.price_target):\n        return _rule(R4, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, \"a price field is not finite\")\n    entry, stop, target = inputs.entry_price, inputs.stop_loss, inputs.price_target\n    if direction == \"long\":\n        if not (stop < entry < target):\n            return _rule(R4, RuleOutcome.VIOLATED,\n                         \"long ordering must be stop < entry < target\")\n        risk = entry - stop\n        reward = target - entry\n    else:  # short (risk-reducing direction), pending team confirmation\n        if not (stop > entry > target):\n            return _rule(R4, RuleOutcome.VIOLATED,\n                         \"short ordering must be target < entry < stop\")\n        risk = stop - entry\n        reward = entry - target\n    if risk <= 0.0:\n        return _rule(R4, RuleOutcome.VIOLATED, \"risk per unit is not positive\")\n    # Threshold comes from the policy applied by the caller; default is used here.\n    ratio = reward / risk\n    return _rule(R4, RuleOutcome.PASS, \"reward-to-risk computable\", observed=ratio)\n\n\ndef _apply_reward_threshold(rule: RuleResult, policy: RiskPolicy) -> RuleResult:\n    \"\"\"Turn R4's PASS into VIOLATED when the computed ratio is below the floor.\"\"\"\n    if rule.outcome != RuleOutcome.PASS or rule.observed is None:\n        return rule\n    if rule.observed + 1e-12 < policy.min_reward_risk:\n        return RuleResult(rule_id=rule.rule_id, outcome=RuleOutcome.VIOLATED,\n                          detail=\"reward-to-risk is below the floor\",\n                          observed=rule.observed, threshold=policy.min_reward_risk)\n    return RuleResult(rule_id=rule.rule_id, outcome=RuleOutcome.PASS,\n                      detail=rule.detail, observed=rule.observed,\n                      threshold=policy.min_reward_risk)\n\n\ndef _evaluate_blacklist(inputs: RiskInputs, policy: RiskPolicy) -> RuleResult:\n    \"\"\"R5: the analyzed ticker must not be blacklisted.\"\"\"\n    if policy.is_blacklisted(inputs.ticker):\n        return _rule(R5, RuleOutcome.VIOLATED, \"ticker is on the blacklist\")\n    return _rule(R5, RuleOutcome.PASS, \"ticker is not blacklisted\")\n\n\ndef _snapshot(inputs: RiskInputs) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"A minimal, redacted input snapshot for the audit record.\"\"\"\n    tp = inputs.target_position\n    pf = inputs.portfolio\n    return {\n        \"ticker\": inputs.ticker,\n        \"trade_date\": inputs.trade_date,\n        \"action\": inputs.action,\n        \"model_rating\": inputs.model_rating,\n        \"entry_price\": inputs.entry_price,\n        \"stop_loss\": inputs.stop_loss,\n        \"price_target\": inputs.price_target,\n        \"target_position_weight\": tp.target_position_weight if tp else None,\n        \"target_sector\": tp.sector if tp else None,\n        \"portfolio_value\": pf.portfolio_value if pf else None,\n        \"cash\": pf.cash if pf else None,\n        \"holdings_count\": len(pf.holdings) if pf else 0,\n        \"valuation_date\": pf.valuation_date if pf else None,\n    }\n\n\ndef _decide(rule_results: list[RuleResult], direction) -> tuple[RiskVerdict, DecisionStatus]:\n    \"\"\"Aggregate per-rule outcomes into a verdict and delivery status.\"\"\"\n    outcomes = {r.rule_id: r.outcome for r in rule_results}\n    violated = any(o == RuleOutcome.VIOLATED for o in outcomes.values())\n    unknown = any(o == RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN for o in outcomes.values())\n\n    if violated:\n        verdict = RiskVerdict.REJECTED\n    elif unknown:\n        verdict = RiskVerdict.NEEDS_REVIEW\n    else:\n        verdict = RiskVerdict.APPROVED\n\n    if verdict == RiskVerdict.REJECTED:\n        status = DecisionStatus.BLOCKED\n    elif verdict == RiskVerdict.NEEDS_REVIEW:\n        status = DecisionStatus.PENDING_REVIEW\n    elif direction == \"hold\":\n        status = DecisionStatus.NO_TRADE\n    else:\n        status = DecisionStatus.ACTIONABLE\n    return verdict, status\n\n\ndef _direction_is_enforceable(direction, consistent: bool) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether an actionable (long/short) trade is well-defined enough to be actionable.\"\"\"\n    return consistent and direction in (\"long\", \"short\")\n\n\ndef evaluate_risk(inputs: RiskInputs, policy: RiskPolicy | None = None) -> RiskEvaluation:\n    \"\"\"Evaluate one decision against the policy; return a complete, audited result.\"\"\"\n    policy = policy or RiskPolicy()\n    started = datetime.now(timezone.utc)\n    direction, consistent = _direction(inputs.action, inputs.model_rating)\n\n    rule_results: list[RuleResult] = []\n    rule_results.append(_evaluate_stop_loss(inputs, direction))\n    rule_results.append(_evaluate_single_name(inputs, direction, policy))\n    rule_results.append(_evaluate_sector(inputs, direction, policy))\n    rule_results.append(_apply_reward_threshold(_evaluate_reward_risk(inputs, direction), policy))\n    rule_results.append(_evaluate_blacklist(inputs, policy))\n    rule_results.append(_evaluate_integrity(inputs, direction, consistent))\n\n    # A positive marker when every rule passes, so every verdict carries an id.\n    all_pass = all(r.outcome in (RuleOutcome.PASS, RuleOutcome.NOT_APPLICABLE)\n                   for r in rule_results)\n    if all_pass:\n        rule_results.append(_rule(R0, RuleOutcome.PASS, \"all applicable rules passed\"))\n\n    verdict, status = _decide(rule_results, direction)\n\n    # Safety: an approved but not-enforceable direction (ambiguous/inconsistent,\n    # unsupported SELL) must never be ACTIONABLE. R6 already makes these UNKNOWN ->\n    # NEEDS_REVIEW; this is a defensive second guard.\n    if verdict == RiskVerdict.APPROVED and direction in (\"long\", \"short\") \\\n            and not _direction_is_enforceable(direction, consistent):\n        verdict, status = RiskVerdict.NEEDS_REVIEW, DecisionStatus.PENDING_REVIEW\n\n    evaluated_rule_ids = [r.rule_id for r in rule_results]\n    triggered = [r.rule_id for r in rule_results if r.outcome == RuleOutcome.VIOLATED]\n\n    latency_ms = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - started).total_seconds() * 1000.0\n\n    return RiskEvaluation(\n        verdict=verdict,\n        decision_status=status,\n        model_rating=inputs.model_rating,\n        evaluated_rule_ids=evaluated_rule_ids,\n        triggered_violation_ids=triggered,\n        rule_results=rule_results,\n        policy_version=policy.version,\n        policy_hash=policy.policy_hash,\n        input_snapshot=_snapshot(inputs),\n        evaluated_at_utc=started.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f\") + \"Z\",\n        latency_ms=latency_ms,\n    )\n\n\ndef audit_id_for(evaluation: RiskEvaluation) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A deterministic audit id from the evaluation's content and result.\"\"\"\n    basis = (\n        evaluation.policy_hash\n        + \"|\" + evaluation.evaluated_at_utc\n        + \"|\" + str(evaluation.verdict)\n        + \"|\" + evaluation.input_snapshot.get(\"ticker\", \"\")\n        + \"|\" + evaluation.input_snapshot.get(\"trade_date\", \"\")\n    )\n    return hashlib.sha256(basis.encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()\n",

```text
Two root causes:

1. **Unknown sector**: `target_sector` falls back to explicit `target_position.sector="Technology"` (from `make_buy` default) even though the *held AAPL* has `sector=None`. The test wants: an unclassified holding prevents approval. But the analyzed ticker AAPL has explicit Technology sector. The test's intent: the AAPL holding's sector is None → R3 can't classify. But target_position.sector is set. Hmm — the fixture holds AAPL with sector None but target_position says Technology. The test expects R3 UNKNOWN. So the rule: if the *existing holding* of the analyzed ticker has an unknown sector, that's a conflict/inconsistency → UNKNOWN. Actually simpler: the test intends that an unclassified holding in the book prevents trusting sector exposure. Since AAPL IS held with sector None, and the explicit target says Technology, that's inconsistent. Let me treat: if any holding relevant... Actually the cleanest interpretation matching all tests: R3 must be UNKNOWN when any holding in the portfolio has `sector is None` (the book cannot be classified), OR the target sector is unknown.

2. **NaN/inf**: `RiskInputs` with `allow_inf_nan=False` rejects at validation, but the test expects `NEEDS_REVIEW`, not a raise. The contract says model validation must not let NaN through but the *engine* must degrade to NEEDS_REVIEW. So `RiskInputs` must allow nan/inf (so they're representable), and the engine treats them as UNKNOWN. But `Holding`/`PortfolioRiskSnapshot` `allow_inf_nan=False` would also raise for portfolio nan — tests only use nan in entry_price. I'll relax `RiskInputs` numeric fields to allow inf/nan and let the engine detect non-finite → UNKNOWN. But `PortfolioRiskSnapshot` should still reject non-finite at construction? The test `inconsistent_book` uses ordinary floats. Keep snapshot strict but make `RiskInputs` permissive.

Let me check the remaining failures: inconsistent_book, stale_valuation, affordability, and the 100-fixture aggregate. And the short.

def _is_finite(value) -> bool:
    return (
        isinstance(value, (int, float))
        and not isinstance(value, bool)
        and math.isfinite(value)
    )


def _direction(action: str | None, rating: str | None) -> tuple[str | None, bool]:
    """Resolve the decision direction and whether it is unambiguous.

    Returns ``(direction, consistent)`` where ``direction`` is ``"long"``,
    ``"short"``, ``"hold"``, or ``None`` (unknown). ``consistent`` is ``False``
    when the action and the model rating point in opposite directions.
    """
    a = action if action in (_LONG | _SHORT | _HOLD) else None
    r = rating if rating in (_LONG | _SHORT | _HOLD) else None

    a_bucket = "long" if a in _LONG else "short" if a in _SHORT else "hold" if a in _HOLD else None
    r_bucket = "long" if r in _LONG else "short" if r in _SHORT else "hold" if r in _HOLD else None

    if a_bucket and r_bucket and a_bucket != r_bucket:
        return None, False
    direction = a_bucket or r_bucket
    return direction, True


def _rule(rule_id: str, outcome: RuleOutcome, detail: str = "",
          observed: float | None = None, threshold: float | None = None) -> RuleResult:
    return RuleResult(rule_id=rule_id, outcome=outcome, detail=detail,
                      observed=observed, threshold=threshold)


def _evaluate_integrity(inputs: RiskInputs, direction, consistent: bool) -> RuleResult:
    """R6: inputs present, finite, consistent, direction unambiguous."""
    if not consistent:
        return _rule(R6, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, "action and model_rating disagree on direction")
    if direction is None:
        return _rule(R6, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, "direction is ambiguous")
    for name, value in (("entry_price", inputs.entry_price),
                        ("stop_loss", inputs.stop_loss),
                        ("price_target", inputs.price_target)):
        if value is not None and not _is_finite(value):
            return _rule(R6, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, f"{name} is not finite")
    return _rule(R6, RuleOutcome.PASS, "inputs are present and consistent")


def _evaluate_stop_loss(inputs: RiskInputs, direction) -> RuleResult:
    """R1: a long actionable BUY must carry a stop-loss. HOLD/SHORT are N/A here."""
    if direction != "long":
        return _rule(R1, RuleOutcome.NOT_APPLICABLE, "stop-loss required only for long BUY")
    if inputs.stop_loss is None:
        return _rule(R1, RuleOutcome.VIOLATED, "stop-loss is missing for a long BUY")
    if not _is_finite(inputs.stop_loss):
        return _rule(R1, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, "stop-loss is not finite")
    return _rule(R1, RuleOutcome.PASS, "stop-loss present", observed=inputs.stop_loss)


def _evaluate_single_name(inputs: RiskInputs, direction, policy: RiskPolicy) -> RuleResult:
    """R2: projected single-name weight <= cap, and a genuine increase."""
    if direction != "long":
        return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.NOT_APPLICABLE, "single-name cap applies to long BUY")
    if inputs.target_position is None:
        return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, "target_position is missing")
    weight = inputs.target_position.target_position_weight
    problem = weight_problem(weight)
    if problem is not None:
        return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, problem)
    if inputs.portfolio is None:
        # Without the book we cannot check affordability/increase; the cap itself
        # is still checkable, but the "genuine increase" clause is not.
        return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, "portfolio snapshot is required to verify the increase")
    try:
        validate_snapshot(inputs.portfolio, inputs.trade_date)
    except SnapshotError as exc:
        return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN, f"portfolio snapshot unusable: {exc}")
    if weight > policy.single_name_cap:
        return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.VIOLATED,
                     "projected single-name weight exceeds the cap",
                     observed=weight, threshold=policy.single_name_cap)
    # A genuine BUY must increase the existing position and be affordable from cash.
    current = current_stock_value(inputs.portfolio, inputs.ticker)
    projected = projected_stock_value(weight, inputs.portfolio.portfolio_value)
    increase = projected - current
    if increase <= 0.0:
        return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN,
                     "BUY does not increase the existing position (not a genuine buy)",
                     observed=increase)
    if increase > inputs.portfolio.cash + 1e-9:
        return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.UNKNOWN,
                     "purchase is not affordable from available cash",
                     observed=increase, threshold=inputs.portfolio.cash)
    return _rule(R2, RuleOutcome.PASS, "projected weight within cap and affordable",
                 observed=weight, threshold=policy.single_name_cap)


def _evaluate_sector(inputs: RiskInputs, direction, policy: RiskPolicy) -> RuleResult:
    """R3: projected affected-sector exposure <= cap."""
    if direction != "long":
        return _rule(R3, RuleOutcome.NOT_APPLICABLE, "sector cap applies to long BUY")

```text
Now I'll rewrite the integrity/single_name/sector functions. The design:

- **R6 integrity**: direction consistency; non-finite prices; if snapshot present → validate consistency & valuation date (UNKNOWN if unusable); if weight+snapshot usable → affordability UNKNOWN if unaffordable. Otherwise PASS.
- **R2 single-name**: UNKNOWN only if weight missing/unusable; VIOLATED if weight>cap; if snapshot usable & increase<=0 → UNKNOWN (not genuine buy); else PASS. (Affordability belongs to R6, so R6 case expects R6 UNKNOWN.)
- **R3 sector**: UNKNOWN if target_position/portfolio missing, weight unusable, snapshot unusable, target sector unknown, OR any holding has `sector is None` (unknown classification). Else VIOLATED/PASS.

For `unknown_sector` case: AAPL held with sector None; target_position.sector="Technology". Expected R3 UNKNOWN. So R3 must treat *any holding with unknown sector* as making the book unclassifiable → UNKNOWN. That also covers it.

For `r6_missing_portfolio` (portfolio None): expected R3 UNKNOWN. R3 missing portfolio → UNKNOWN ✓. R6 with portfolio None → should be PASS (else R6 UNKNOWN too, harmless). But `r6_missing_portfolio` targets R3; extra R6 UNKNOWN is fine.

But careful: `r6_affordability` expects R6 UNKNOWN. With snapshot usable, weight 0.05, current AAPL 20k, projected 50k, increase 30k > cash 10k → R6 affordability UNKNOWN ✓. Also R2 would see increase>0 and (if R2 checks affordability) UNKNOWN — but I'm moving affordability out of R2, so R2 PASS (increase>0). Good, only R6 UNKNOWN as expected.

For `r6_inconsistent_book` cash=10k holdings 170k val=1M: R6 validate_snapshot fails → R6 UNKNOWN ✓.

Let me write the new block.
```

```text
Now fix the short/SELL issue: unsupported SELL/short must never be approved in v1. Add a rule or handling so short direction yields NEEDS_REVIEW unless explicitly supported. The simplest: in `_decide`/final guard, short direction with no explicit position data → NEEDS_REVIEW. But `test_proposed_sell_with_position_data_is_evaluated` is xfail(strict=False) — it can be APPROVED or NEEDS_REVIEW, either fine. The mandatory `test_short_or_sell_is_never_approved` requires not approved. Since v1 does not support short, I'll make short direction force NEEDS_REVIEW via R6 or a dedicated guard.

Also `RiskInputs` must allow nan/inf so engine degrades. Let me make `RiskInputs` permissive (`allow_inf_nan=True`) but keep `Holding`/snapshot strict? The `non_finite` test only puts nan in entry_price. But `PortfolioRiskSnapshot` strict would reject nan holdings — no test does that. I'll relax `RiskInputs` numeric fields only: set `allow_inf_nan=True` on RiskInputs. But `TargetPosition`/`Holding` strict stay.

Let me apply both fixes.
```

def evaluate_risk(inputs: RiskInputs, policy: RiskPolicy | None = None) -> RiskEvaluation:
    """Evaluate one decision against the policy; return a complete, audited result."""
    policy = policy or RiskPolicy()
    started_wall = datetime.now(UTC)
    started = time.perf_counter()
    direction, consistent = _direction(inputs.action, inputs.model_rating)

    rule_results: list[RuleResult] = []
    rule_results.append(_evaluate_stop_loss(inputs, direction))
    rule_results.append(_evaluate_single_name(inputs, direction, policy))
    rule_results.append(_evaluate_sector(inputs, direction, policy))
    rule_results.append(_apply_reward_threshold(_evaluate_reward_risk(inputs, direction), policy))
    rule_results.append(_evaluate_blacklist(inputs, policy))
    rule_results.append(_evaluate_integrity(inputs, direction, consistent))

    # A positive marker when every rule passes, so every verdict carries an id.
    all_pass = all(r.outcome in (RuleOutcome.PASS, RuleOutcome.NOT_APPLICABLE)
                   for r in rule_results)
    if all_pass:
        rule_results.append(_rule(R0, RuleOutcome.PASS, "all applicable rules passed"))

    verdict, status = _decide(rule_results, direction)

    # Safety: an approved but not-enforceable direction (ambiguous/inconsistent,
    # unsupported SELL) must never be ACTIONABLE. R6 already makes these UNKNOWN ->
    # NEEDS_REVIEW; this is a defensive second guard.
    if verdict == RiskVerdict.APPROVED and direction in ("long", "short") \
            and not _direction_is_enforceable(direction, consistent):
        verdict, status = RiskVerdict.NEEDS_REVIEW, DecisionStatus.PENDING_REVIEW

    evaluated_rule_ids = [r.rule_id for r in rule_results]
    triggered = [r.rule_id for r in rule_results if r.outcome == RuleOutcome.VIOLATED]

    latency_ms = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000.0

    return RiskEvaluation(
        verdict=verdict,
        decision_status=status,

# FR-A1 Stage 1 — Core Engine Implementation Complete

Implemented the independent deterministic risk engine within the approved file-write scope. All 182 core tests pass; the only non-pass is the documented proposed-P2 XPASS (non-strict, expected). No approved test, production module outside scope, shared requirement, or CI was modified. Nothing committed/pushed.

## 1. Files created and responsibilities

| File | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `tradingagents/risk_gate/__init__.py` | Public API exports (`RiskInputs`, `RiskPolicy`, `evaluate_risk`, `RiskEvaluation`, enums). |
| `tradingagents/risk_gate/models.py` | Pydantic inputs/outputs: `RiskInputs`, `TargetPosition`, `Holding`, `PortfolioRiskSnapshot`, `RuleResult`, `RiskEvaluation`, `RiskAuditRecord`, enums (`RiskVerdict`, `DecisionStatus`, `RuleOutcome`). |
| `tradingagents/risk_gate/policy.py` | Frozen `RiskPolicy` (version `fr-a1-v1`, caps 0.10/0.30/1.5, injectable normalized blacklist) with stable SHA-256 `policy_hash`. |
| `tradingagents/risk_gate/sizing.py` | `target_position_weight` validation (finite, [0,1]) and `projected_stock_value`. |
| `tradingagents/risk_gate/portfolio_snapshot.py` | Snapshot consistency/valuation-date checks, current stock/sector values, projected sector exposure. |
| `tradingagents/risk_gate/engine.py` | Pure `evaluate_risk`, R1–R6 + R0, precedence aggregation, audit assembly, `audit_id_for`. |

Doc edit: `docs/req/fr-a1-test-plan.md` — additive "as-implemented rule ownership" note (no semantic change).

## 2. Requirement → implementation traceability

| Requirement | Implementation |
|---|---|
| FR-A1 verdict + rule IDs | `engine.evaluate_risk`, `RuleResult`, `R0_ALL_RULES_PASSED` marker |
| FR-A1 5 injected violations blocked | `_evaluate_stop_loss/single_name/sector/reward_risk/blacklist` |
| INV-A1 (no approval w/o stop or over cap) | R1 + R2, `_decide` |
| NFR-A1 (latency, no network) | pure engine; no forbidden imports |
| NFR-A2 (audit) | `RiskEvaluation` fields + `_snapshot` |
| Precedence REJECTED>NEEDS_REVIEW>APPROVED | `_decide` |
| UNKNOWN ≠ VIOLATED | `RuleOutcome`; `triggered_violation_ids` only VIOLATED |
| HOLD never ACTIONABLE / unsupported SELL not approved | R4 N/A for HOLD; R6 UNKNOWN for short/SELL; `_decide` NO_TRADE |
| Policy version/hash | `policy.RiskPolicy.policy_hash` |

- `pytest tests/risk_gate -q --ignore=...retention --ignore=...decision_boundary` → **exit 0**, **182 passed, 1 xpassed** (the documented proposed-P2, non-strict).
