````json
        "patch": "Index: docs/req/fr-a1-test-plan.md\n===================================================================\n--- docs/req/fr-a1-test-plan.md\t\n+++ docs/req/fr-a1-test-plan.md\t\n@@ -1,470 +1,503 @@\n # FR-A1 Test Plan — Deterministic Risk Gate\n \n - Status: Authoring approved; production implementation blocked pending review of these tests.\n - Date: 2026-11-11\n - Owner: A\n - Requirement: FR-A1, with INV-A1, NFR-A1, NFR-A2\n - Related ADR: `docs/architecture/adr/adr-fr-a1-risk-gate.md`\n - Baseline: `46bde74`\n \n This plan describes the agreed contract and its offline test coverage. It is\n written before production implementation so the tests can be reviewed. Tests\n reference the requirement/invariant they enforce. Intentional safety-related\n behavior changes are marked `[SAFETY]`; everything else must remain an existing\n behavior (`[PRESERVE]`).\n \n ## 1. Proposed interface (contract under review)\n \n The tests are written against this interface. It is expected to match the\n eventual implementation; production code is not written yet.\n \n ### 1.1 Package `tradingagents.risk_gate`\n \n Modules (proposed): `models.py`, `policy.py`, `engine.py`, `sizing.py`,\n `portfolio_snapshot.py`, `node.py` (integration). The core engine modules have no\n network, no file I/O, no LLM imports.\n \n ### 1.2 Enumerations\n \n ```python\n class RiskVerdict(StrEnum):\n     APPROVED = \"APPROVED\"\n     REJECTED = \"REJECTED\"\n     NEEDS_REVIEW = \"NEEDS_REVIEW\"\n \n class DecisionStatus(StrEnum):\n     ACTIONABLE = \"ACTIONABLE\"\n     BLOCKED = \"BLOCKED\"\n     PENDING_REVIEW = \"PENDING_REVIEW\"\n     NO_TRADE = \"NO_TRADE\"\n \n class RuleOutcome(StrEnum):\n     PASS = \"PASS\"\n     VIOLATED = \"VIOLATED\"\n     NOT_APPLICABLE = \"NOT_APPLICABLE\"\n     UNKNOWN = \"UNKNOWN\"\n ```\n \n ### 1.3 Rule identifiers\n \n | ID | Meaning |\n |---|---|\n | `R1_STOP_LOSS_REQUIRED` | Long actionable BUY must carry a stop-loss |\n | `R2_SINGLE_NAME_CAP` | Projected single-name weight ≤ 10% (0.10) |\n | `R3_SECTOR_CONCENTRATION` | Projected sector exposure ≤ 30% (0.30) |\n | `R4_REWARD_RISK` | Direction-aware reward-to-risk ≥ 1.5 and ordering stop<entry<target |\n | `R5_BLACKLIST` | Ticker not on the deterministic blacklist |\n | `R6_INPUT_INTEGRITY` | Structured inputs present, consistent, unambiguous |\n | `R0_ALL_RULES_PASSED` | Positive marker so every verdict carries a rule ID |\n \n `R0` is a synthetic \"pass\" entry: every evaluation carries at least one rule ID,\n satisfying \"100% of verdicts carry a rule identifier\" (`requirements.yaml:28`),\n including clean approvals.\n \n ### 1.4 Input models\n \n ```python\n class TargetPosition(BaseModel):\n     target_position_weight: float | None   # projected post-trade single-name weight, 0..1\n     sector: str | None = None               # target stock's sector, required when not held\n \n class Holding(BaseModel):\n     ticker: str\n     market_value: float          # current market value; never average cost\n     sector: str | None\n \n class PortfolioRiskSnapshot(BaseModel):\n     valuation_date: str          # ISO date; must be consistent with the run's trade_date\n     portfolio_value: float       # total portfolio value used for weight denominators\n     cash: float                  # cash available to fund a cash-funded long\n     holdings: list[Holding]\n     # consistency: cash + Σ holdings.market_value == portfolio_value\n \n class RiskInputs(BaseModel):\n     ticker: str\n     trade_date: str\n     action: str | None           # TraderProposal.action, if structured output produced it\n     entry_price: float | None\n     stop_loss: float | None\n     price_target: float | None   # PortfolioDecision.price_target\n     model_rating: str | None     # PortfolioDecision.rating, verbatim\n     target_position: TargetPosition | None\n     portfolio: PortfolioRiskSnapshot | None\n ```\n \n **Projected exposure (cash-funded long, documented for v1):**\n `projected_stock_value = target_position_weight * portfolio_value`;\n `projected_sector_value = current_sector_value - current_stock_value +\n projected_stock_value`. A genuine BUY increases the position and the purchase\n (`projected_stock_value - current_stock_value`) is affordable from `cash`. Missing\n target sector for an unheld stock, or an inconsistent snapshot, makes the affected\n rule `UNKNOWN` → `NEEDS_REVIEW`, never `APPROVED`.\n \n ### 1.5 Output models\n \n ```python\n class RuleResult(BaseModel):\n     rule_id: str\n     outcome: RuleOutcome\n     detail: str                      # deterministic; no PII/credentials\n     observed: float | None = None\n     threshold: float | None = None\n \n class RiskEvaluation(BaseModel):\n     verdict: RiskVerdict\n     decision_status: DecisionStatus\n     model_rating: str | None\n     evaluated_rule_ids: list[str]        # every rule considered\n     triggered_violation_ids: list[str]   # only VIOLATED rule ids\n     rule_results: list[RuleResult]       # complete per-rule results\n     policy_version: str\n     policy_hash: str\n     input_snapshot: dict                 # minimal, redacted snapshot\n     evaluated_at_utc: str                # ISO8601 UTC\n     latency_ms: float\n \n class RiskAuditRecord(BaseModel):\n     audit_id: str\n     evaluation: RiskEvaluation\n ```\n \n ### 1.6 Engine entry points\n \n ```python\n def evaluate_risk(inputs: RiskInputs, policy: RiskPolicy | None = None) -> RiskEvaluation: ...\n \n class RiskPolicy:\n     version: str          # \"fr-a1-v1\"\n     policy_hash: str      # stable hash of the constants\n     single_name_cap: float = 0.10\n     sector_cap: float = 0.30\n     min_reward_risk: float = 1.5\n     blacklist: frozenset[str] = frozenset()\n ```\n \n `evaluate_risk` is pure and deterministic. Ticker normalization uses\n `tradingagents.dataflows.symbols.normalize_symbol`.\n \n ## 2. Rule semantics and applicability\n \n Precedence for the final verdict: `REJECTED > NEEDS_REVIEW > APPROVED`.\n \n **UNKNOWN is not VIOLATED.** `triggered_violation_ids` lists only rules whose\n outcome is `VIOLATED`; `evaluated_rule_ids` lists every rule considered. When a\n rule cannot be decided for lack of input it is `UNKNOWN` (→ `NEEDS_REVIEW`), not a\n violation. Example: a missing stop-loss makes `R1` `VIOLATED` while `R4` is\n `UNKNOWN` (the ratio cannot be computed).\n \n **Three separate concepts at the boundary:** `model_rating` (the PM's own rating,\n preserved), `risk_verdict` (from the gate), and the *effective public signal*\n (a non-`APPROVED` actionable direction surfaces as the existing `REVIEW`\n sentinel). `final_rating`/`run_rating` keep their baseline meaning — the **model**\n rating — and are not redefined; the gate produces the effective public signal\n separately so blocked recommendations cannot escape as an actionable BUY.\n \n | Rule | Applies when | Violated → | Unknown/inapplicable → |\n |---|---|---|---|\n | R1 stop-loss | long actionable BUY (action Buy) | REJECTED | — |\n | R2 single-name | BUY with a resolvable weight | REJECTED (>0.10) | NEEDS_REVIEW (R2 UNKNOWN: missing weight) |\n | R3 sector | BUY with a resolvable snapshot | REJECTED (>0.30) | NEEDS_REVIEW (R3 UNKNOWN: unknown sector/value) |\n | R4 reward-risk | BUY with entry/stop/target | REJECTED (ratio<1.5 or bad ordering) | NEEDS_REVIEW (R4 UNKNOWN: missing leg) |\n | R5 blacklist | any ticker | REJECTED (on list) | — (list always known) |\n | R6 input integrity | always | — | NEEDS_REVIEW (R6 UNKNOWN: missing/contradictory/inconsistent) |\n \n BUY: all of R1–R5 apply. HOLD: no actionable trade; approved HOLD → `NO_TRADE`\n (R4 `NOT_APPLICABLE` is a pending decision). SELL/short without explicit\n existing-position and trade data → not `APPROVED` (mandatory); exact risk-reducing\n criteria are pending team confirmation. The sector cap applies to the **affected\n sector** of the target stock in v1 (scope pending confirmation).\n \n **As-implemented rule ownership (no semantic change, just allocation):**\n - R2 checks the weight cap and the *genuine increase* clause (UNKNOWN when the\n   buy does not increase the position).\n - R3 checks projected affected-sector exposure (UNKNOWN when a holding lacks a\n   sector, or the target sector is unknown).\n - R6 checks input integrity that spans rules: contradictory/ambiguous direction,\n   non-finite decision prices, an inconsistent or stale portfolio snapshot, and an\n   unaffordable cash-funded purchase. In v1, an unsupported short/SELL is recorded\n   by R6 as UNKNOWN (pending team confirmation), so it cannot be approved.\n - Decision numeric fields are representable as `inf`/`nan` at the model layer so a\n   malformed value degrades to UNKNOWN (NEEDS_REVIEW); it can never become a usable\n   number or an approval.\n \n ## 3. Requirement traceability\n \n | Requirement | Contract element | Test file |\n |---|---|---|\n | FR-A1 verdict + rule IDs | `evaluate_risk`, `rule_results` | `test_rules.py`, `test_verdict_semantics.py` |\n | FR-A1 5 injected violations 5/5 blocked | R1–R5 fixtures | `test_rule_violations.py` |\n | FR-A1 100 invalid fixtures 0 approvals | fixture generator | `test_100_invalid_fixtures.py` |\n | INV-A1 no approval without stop / over cap | invariants | `test_invariants.py` |\n | NFR-A1 p95 ≤ 2 s, 0 network | pure engine + runtime/structural guard | `test_latency_no_network.py` |\n | NFR-A2 audit completeness | `RiskAuditRecord` | `test_audit_trail.py` |\n | §5.1 verdict affects recommendation | boundary enforcement | `test_decision_boundary.py` |\n | §5.2 NO_TRADE for approved HOLD | `DecisionStatus` | `test_verdict_semantics.py` |\n | §5.3 structured weight/snapshot | `TargetPosition`, `PortfolioRiskSnapshot` | `test_input_contract.py` |\n | §5.4 trade scope | applicability | `test_trade_scope.py` |\n | §5.5 policy version/hash | `RiskPolicy` | `test_policy_versioning.py` |\n | Structured retention (API+CLI) | state keys | `test_integration_retention.py` |\n \n ## 4. Test matrix\n \n All tests are `@pytest.mark.unit`, offline (the repo's `conftest.py` already\n blocks sockets), parameterized deterministically. Files live under `tests/risk_gate/`.\n \n ### 4.1 Rule-level (`test_rules.py`)\n \n - R1: BUY missing stop → REJECTED, id `R1_STOP_LOSS_REQUIRED`.\n - R2: weight 0.12 → REJECTED; weight 0.10 → PASS; weight 0.099 → PASS.\n - R3: sector 0.35 → REJECTED; 0.30 → PASS.\n - R4: long RR 2.0 → PASS; RR 0.5 → REJECTED; short direction-aware.\n - R5: blacklisted ticker → REJECTED; normalization for `aapl`/`AAPL`.\n - Valid BUY (all in bounds) → APPROVED, `R0_ALL_RULES_PASSED` present.\n - Wrong-side stop (long stop ≥ entry) → REJECTED; wrong-side target → REJECTED.\n \n ### 4.2 Exact boundaries (`test_boundaries.py`)\n \n - 10% weight: `0.10` PASS, next representable above → REJECTED. The fixture holds a\n   positive AAPL position, so a target weight of `0.0` (and a target equal to the\n   held value) is **not approved** — a genuine BUY must increase the position.\n - 30% **projected post-trade** sector: `0.30` PASS (inclusive), just over REJECTED.\n - 1.5 RR: exactly `1.5` PASS; `1.4999...` REJECTED.\n \n ### 4.3 Injected violations (`test_rule_violations.py`)\n \n Five individually isolated fixtures, each asserting the expected rule id is\n `VIOLATED` and verdict `REJECTED`, with the *other* rules not violated: missing\n stop (R1; R4 may be UNKNOWN), single-name 12% (R2), projected sector 40% (R3),\n RR 0.5 (R4), blacklist (R5).\n \n ### 4.4 Malformed / missing inputs (`test_input_contract.py`)\n \n - Missing target position/weight → NEEDS_REVIEW, R2 `UNKNOWN`, PENDING_REVIEW.\n - Missing portfolio/sector → NEEDS_REVIEW, R3 `UNKNOWN`.\n - Missing target price → NEEDS_REVIEW, R4 `UNKNOWN`.\n - NaN/inf prices → NEEDS_REVIEW, never ACTIONABLE.\n - Contradictory proposal/decision direction → NEEDS_REVIEW (R6 `UNKNOWN`).\n - Inconsistent snapshot (holdings+cash ≠ portfolio_value), stale valuation date,\n   unaffordable purchase → NEEDS_REVIEW, never ACTIONABLE.\n \n ### 4.5 Verdict semantics (`test_verdict_semantics.py`)\n \n - Precedence REJECTED > NEEDS_REVIEW > APPROVED.\n - All applicable rules collected (no first-fail).\n - UNKNOWN is distinct from VIOLATED; `triggered_violation_ids` lists only VIOLATED.\n - `triggered_violation_ids` ⊆ `evaluated_rule_ids`; both present for clean runs.\n - Approved HOLD → `NO_TRADE`; approved BUY → `ACTIONABLE`; rejected → `BLOCKED`;\n   needs-review → `PENDING_REVIEW`; model rating preserved on reject.\n \n ### 4.6 Trade scope (`test_trade_scope.py`)\n \n Mandatory (hard assertions, not xfail): HOLD never ACTIONABLE; SELL/short without\n explicit position+trade data never APPROVED; ambiguous direction never APPROVED.\n A `test_proposed_*` records the pending SELL-with-data expectation separately.\n \n ### 4.7 Invariants (`test_invariants.py`)\n \n - APPROVED ⇒ stop-loss present for actionable BUY.\n - APPROVED ⇒ weight ≤ 0.10.\n - APPROVED ⇒ decision_status in {ACTIONABLE, NO_TRADE}.\n - Sweep over deterministic grid: no APPROVED violates INV-A1.\n \n ### 4.8 100 invalid fixtures (`test_100_invalid_fixtures.py`)\n \n Simple, independent, reproducible parameterized cases (no fragile dictionary-\n merging cross-products that could overwrite `target_position` or other inputs).\n Exactly 100 **distinct** fixtures are exercised; distinctness is keyed on the\n actual input payload and the policy (blacklist), excluding the case label.\n \n Cases span **all five rules plus input-integrity failures** (R1–R6). Every\n blacklist fixture explicitly blacklists the analyzed ticker (AAPL), so R5 applies.\n Each case declares the rule it targets and the outcome that rule must record:\n \n - `VIOLATED` cases assert the expected rule id is present with `VIOLATED` and is in\n   `triggered_violation_ids`.\n - `UNKNOWN` (input-integrity) cases assert the referenced rule is `UNKNOWN` and is\n   **not** falsely recorded as `VIOLATED`.\n - Aggregate: **0 of 100 APPROVED**, none ACTIONABLE; all of R1–R5 plus an\n   input-integrity `UNKNOWN` outcome are represented; the 100 are distinct.\n - A dedicated test asserts every blacklist fixture includes the analyzed ticker.\n \n The affordability fixture uses a consistent 1,000,000 book (cash 10,000, AAPL\n 20,000, MSFT 150,000, others 820,000 across several non-Technology sectors); target\n weight 0.05 → projected AAPL 50,000 (+30,000 increase) but only 10,000 cash, so R2\n (0.05 ≤ 0.10) and R3 (Technology 20%) pass and affordability is the only blocker,\n yielding `NEEDS_REVIEW` under the `REJECTED > NEEDS_REVIEW > APPROVED` precedence.\n \n ### 4.9 Audit (`test_audit_trail.py`)\n \n - Required *values* verified (policy hash length, UTC timestamp format, latency,\n   snapshot non-empty and value-bearing), not mere key presence.\n - 10 evaluations → 100% audit coverage with identical version/hash.\n - No credentials or raw prompt fields.\n \n ### 4.10 Policy versioning (`test_policy_versioning.py`)\n \n - `version == \"fr-a1-v1\"`; `policy_hash` stable; distinct hash when a threshold\n   changes; version/hash recorded in evaluation.\n \n ### 4.11 Latency / no network (`test_latency_no_network.py`)\n \n - 1000 evaluations; measured **core** p95 ≤ 2000 ms; the measured p50/p95 is\n   reported in the test output. Core latency is distinguished from integration\n   overhead (graph wiring is covered separately).\n - A runtime socket guard (every connect/`getaddrinfo` refuses) is installed for the\n   evaluation loop; a subprocess structural check asserts importing the engine\n   alone pulls in no network/LLM module.\n \n ### 4.12 Integration acceptance (`test_integration_retention.py`, `test_decision_boundary.py`)\n \n **These are NOT approved for the core stage.** They are retained for the later\n integration stage and will require separate review and approval before integration.\n They exercise graph/CLI/checkpoint code and are expected to fail (RED) until that\n stage. `[SAFETY]`/`[PRESERVE]` marked, real graph/CLI behavioral tests (not\n existence checks).\n \n - Programmatic API: **unconditional** assertions for REJECTED and for NEEDS_REVIEW —\n   expected `risk_verdict`, effective public signal `REVIEW`, preserved\n   `model_rating`, and `decision_status` (`BLOCKED`/`PENDING_REVIEW`).\n - CLI stream path: a real `run_analysis` drive with a scripted streamed REJECTED\n   BUY verifies the decision recorded downstream is not an actionable BUY\n   (effective signal `REVIEW`, `decision_status` BLOCKED, `model_rating` kept).\n - Structured objects retained in state without Markdown parsing (`[SAFETY]`).\n - Audit persistence: state log records `risk_verdict` and `policy_version`\n   (`[SAFETY]`).\n - Checkpoint safety: the run signature carries a `risk_gate` **marker**, and a\n   pre-gate checkpoint cannot resume into a gated graph — asserted structurally on\n   the marker list, not by searching a hash for a word (`[SAFETY]`).\n - Existing rendered strings and `run_rating` (model rating) unchanged (`[PRESERVE]`).\n \n ## 5. Expected outcomes before implementation\n \n Because production code is absent, the risk-gate tests import the engine at test\n execution time and fail (RED) with `ModuleNotFoundError: tradingagents.risk_gate`.\n There is **no module-level importorskip and no production stub**. Test files are\n collected before implementation; individual tests fail for real, proving they\n exercise the gate. Collection succeeds; failures are the honest pre-implementation\n state, never counted as passes. The existing regression suite must be unaffected\n (`[PRESERVE]`).\n \n ## 6. Intentional safety changes vs regression\n \n - `[SAFETY]` items intentionally change observable behavior at the decision\n   boundary (non-APPROVED directions become `REVIEW`/blocked). These are not\n   regressions.\n - `[PRESERVE]` items must remain identical; failing ones indicate unintended\n   regression and must not be \"fixed\" by weakening assertions.\n \n ## 7. Pending scope decisions (recorded separately)\n \n Mandatory safety behavior is encoded as hard assertions, not non-strict xfail.\n Genuinely unresolved policy extensions are recorded as `test_proposed_*` or here:\n \n - P1 HOLD applicability of R4 (proposed: `NOT_APPLICABLE`).\n - P2 SELL risk-reducing criteria and required explicit data (mandatory:\n   unsupported SELL never approved).\n - P3 Blacklist source (proposed: injectable policy).\n - P4 FR-A2 boundary: NEEDS_REVIEW blocked from automatic execution.\n - P5 Sector snapshot additive contract details.\n - P6 Sector-cap scope: affected sector (v1 default) vs all sectors.\n \n ## 8. Staged implementation: core vs integration\n \n Stage 1 (next, on approval) implements **only the independent risk engine** under\n `tradingagents/risk_gate/` (pure, no network/file-I/O/LLM) and its **core** tests.\n It does **not** modify graph, agent, CLI, reporting, rating, memory, or checkpoint\n code. The core-only test command is:\n \n ```\n pytest tests/risk_gate -q \\\n   --ignore=tests/risk_gate/test_integration_retention.py \\\n   --ignore=tests/risk_gate/test_decision_boundary.py\n ```\n \n Stage 2 (later, separate approval) performs integration and the API/CLI/checkpoint\n acceptance tests (`test_integration_retention.py`, `test_decision_boundary.py`).\n Those tests are **not approved** for the core stage and must not be claimed as\n such. Proposed core-stage production files are enumerated in the ADR.\n \n ## 9. Stage 2 integration test plan (tests-only this turn)\n \n The gate is invoked once at the **Portfolio Manager output boundary** (ADR §13),\n so one authoritative evaluation covers the API and CLI paths. The revised tests run\n real graph execution with the existing offline scripted model\n (`tests/test_graph_end_to_end.py`); they do not mock the verdict and do not bypass\n the engine.\n \n ### 9.1 Proposed adapter interface (target of the tests)\n \n ```python\n # tradingagents/risk_gate/adapter.py (proposed)\n def build_inputs(ticker, trade_date, trader_proposal, portfolio_decision,\n                  risk_portfolio) -> RiskInputs: ...\n def apply_gate(ticker, trade_date, trader_proposal, portfolio_decision,\n                risk_portfolio, policy=None) -> dict:\n     # returns state updates: model_rating, risk_verdict, decision_status,\n     # risk_evaluation (RiskEvaluation) and effective_final_rating\n ```\n \n Caller-facing additive config: `risk_portfolio` = `{ snapshot: {...},\n target_position: {target_position_weight, sector} }`. Absent → R6 UNKNOWN\n (fail closed); present and in-bounds → APPROVED.\n \n ### 9.2 Test matrix (`test_decision_boundary.py`, `test_integration_retention.py`)\n \n | Group | Test | Requirement |\n |---|---|---|\n | A API | valid BUY + complete snapshot → APPROVED, signal = model rating, ACTIONABLE | FR-A1, §5.1 |\n | A API | missing stop → REJECTED, signal REVIEW, model_rating kept | INV-A1 |\n | A API | missing snapshot → NEEDS_REVIEW, signal REVIEW | §5.3 fail-closed |\n | B CLI | real `run_analysis` (real graph, real `record_decision`); displayed notice is REVIEW; state log carries verdict | §5.1 |\n | B CLI | default CLI path (no snapshot) fails closed to REVIEW | §5.3, §14.4 |\n | A API | Python API `TradingAgentsGraph(config={\"risk_portfolio\": ...})` can APPROVE | §14.4 |\n | B CLI | no actionable BUY published before evaluation (streamed steps) | §5.1 |\n | C data | both structured objects reach the gate | §6 |\n | C data | free-text fallback cannot bypass inputs (still NEEDS_REVIEW) | §5.3 |\n | C data | validation failure → non-actionable + audit record | NFR-A2 |\n | D audit | rule ids/outcomes, snapshot, verdict, policy v/hash, UTC | NFR-A2 |\n | D audit | numeric exposure inputs + derived R2/R3 values present | §5.3, §14.2 |\n | D audit | no credentials/raw prompts | NFR-SEC |\n | D audit | APPROVED, REJECTED, NEEDS_REVIEW all audited | NFR-A2 |\n | D audit | durable-audit failure cannot release an actionable BUY on the stream | §5.1, §14 |\n | E downstream | model recommendation preserved as evidence; distinct from signal | §5.1 |\n | E downstream | blocked BUY not an authorized BUY in report header/memory | §5.1 |\n | F checkpoint | real resume; pre-gate checkpoint re-evaluates | §13.5 |\n | F checkpoint | legacy (pre-gate) signature checkpoint cannot bypass evaluation | §14, §13.5 |\n | G perf | **actual adapter** overhead (conversion+evaluation+audit) p50/p95 ≤ 2000 ms | NFR-A1 |\n | G perf | 0 extra network calls attributable to the gate | NFR-A1 |\n \n ### 9.3 Expected before integration coding\n \n These tests import `tradingagents.risk_gate.adapter` (and, for the durable-audit\n stream test, a proposed `risk_gate._persist_audit`) and the new state keys; until\n the adapter exists they fail (RED) honestly, not skip. A small number pass on the\n baseline because they assert fail-closed/preserve behavior that already holds\n (`test_audit_persistence_failure_cannot_leave_actionable_signal`,\n `test_audit_failure_does_not_release_actionable_buy_on_stream`,\n `test_existing_full_run_still_reaches_a_decision`). The 195 core tests remain green\n and are not weakened.\n \n ### 9.4 Traceability additions\n \n | Requirement | Integration test |\n |---|---|\n | FR-A1 | A-valid, A-missing-stop, B-cli (3 CLI tests) |\n | INV-A1 | A-missing-stop, C-validation |\n | NFR-A1 | G-perf (real adapter p50/p95), G-network |\n | NFR-A2 | D-audit (all), D-durable-audit-before-publish |\n | FR-E2 (manifest) | D-state-log |\n | §13.5/§14 checkpoint | F-resume, F-legacy |\n \n ### 9.5 Caller configuration path (Python API only)\n \n There is **no** `risk_portfolio` CLI flag or env var, and this stage adds none. The\n only supported caller path for valid inputs is the **Python API**:\n `TradingAgentsGraph(config={\"risk_portfolio\": {...}})`, exercised by the Python-API\n test.         "patch": "Index: tests/risk_gate/test_adapter_safety.py\n===================================================================\n--- tests/risk_gate/test_adapter_safety.py\t\n+++ tests/risk_gate/test_adapter_safety.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,183 @@\n+\"\"\"Adapter safety edges: durable-audit destination, missing Trader action, and\n+malformed caller inputs (FR-A1 Stage 2 review, gaps 1-3).\n+\n+These are test-first: they encode the required behavior and are expected to fail\n+RED where the current adapter is unsafe. They use the adapter directly so the\n+failure is attributable to production code, not to a fake.\n+\n+`apply_gate` must never return an ACTIONABLE recommendation unless a real durable\n+audit was written. Caller inputs are never trusted or invented.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+import pytest\n+\n+from tests.risk_gate.test_decision_boundary import (\n+    RISK_PORTFOLIO,\n+    _buy_decision,\n+    _buy_proposal,\n+)\n+\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+# 1. Durable audit destination\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+\n+\n+def _apply(**kwargs):\n+    from tradingagents.risk_gate.adapter import apply_gate\n+    return apply_gate(\"NVDA\", \"2026-01-09\", _buy_proposal(), _buy_decision(),\n+                      RISK_PORTFOLIO, **kwargs)\n+\n+\n+@pytest.mark.unit\n+def test_approved_without_audit_destination_is_never_actionable():\n+    \"\"\"[SAFETY] An APPROVED decision with no audit_dir cannot be ACTIONABLE.\n+\n+    A valid BUY with a complete snapshot would be APPROVED, but without a durable\n+    audit destination it must not be published as actionable.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    result = _apply(audit_dir=None)\n+    assert not (result[\"final_rating\"] == \"Buy\"\n+                and result[\"decision_status\"] == \"ACTIONABLE\"), result\n+\n+\n+@pytest.mark.unit\n+def test_unusable_audit_directory_cannot_silently_bypass_audit(tmp_path):\n+    \"\"\"[SAFETY] An unusable audit directory must not silently skip persistence.\"\"\"\n+    # A path under an existing *file* cannot be a directory.\n+    blocker = tmp_path / \"not_a_dir\"\n+    blocker.write_text(\"x\")\n+    try:\n+        result = _apply(audit_dir=blocker / \"audit\")\n+    except OSError:\n+        return  # explicit fail-closed on an unwritable destination is acceptable\n+    # If it did not raise, it must not be actionable.\n+    assert result[\"decision_status\"] != \"ACTIONABLE\"\n+\n+\n+@pytest.mark.unit\n+def test_approved_decision_persists_audit_before_publication(tmp_path):\n+    \"\"\"[SAFETY] For an APPROVED decision the audit file exists after the call.\"\"\"\n+    audit_dir = tmp_path / \"audit\"\n+    result = _apply(audit_dir=audit_dir)\n+    assert result[\"decision_status\"] == \"ACTIONABLE\"\n+    files = list(audit_dir.glob(\"risk_audit_*.json\"))\n+    assert files, \"APPROVED decision published without a durable audit file\"\n+\n+\n+@pytest.mark.unit\n+def test_failing_audit_writer_blocks_actionable_output(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n+    \"\"\"[SAFETY] If the durable writer fails, no actionable recommendation returns.\"\"\"\n+    from tradingagents.risk_gate import adapter as adapter_mod\n+\n+    def boom(*a, **k):\n+        raise OSError(\"audit store unavailable\")\n+\n+    monkeypatch.setattr(adapter_mod, \"persist_audit\", boom, raising=True)\n+    with pytest.raises(OSError):\n+        _apply(audit_dir=tmp_path / \"audit\")\n+\n+\n+@pytest.mark.unit\n+def test_ordinary_valid_audit_path_still_approves(tmp_path):\n+    \"\"\"[SAFETY] A normal valid audit path remains capable of APPROVED.\"\"\"\n+    result = _apply(audit_dir=tmp_path / \"audit\")\n+    assert result[\"risk_verdict\"] == \"APPROVED\"\n+    assert result[\"decision_status\"] == \"ACTIONABLE\"\n+    assert result[\"final_rating\"] == \"Buy\"\n+    assert list((tmp_path / \"audit\").glob(\"risk_audit_*.json\"))\n+\n+\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+# 2. Missing structured Trader action\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+\n+\n+@pytest.mark.unit\n+def test_missing_trader_proposal_cannot_be_approved(tmp_path):\n+    \"\"\"[SAFETY] A valid PortfolioDecision rating does not substitute for a missing\n+    TraderProposal. With a complete snapshot and valid BUY info, the run must not\n+    be APPROVED or ACTIONABLE.\"\"\"\n+    from tradingagents.risk_gate.adapter import apply_gate\n+    result = apply_gate(\"NVDA\", \"2026-01-09\", None, _buy_decision(), RISK_PORTFOLIO,\n+                        audit_dir=tmp_path / \"audit\")\n+    assert result[\"risk_verdict\"] != \"APPROVED\"\n+    assert result[\"decision_status\"] != \"ACTIONABLE\"\n+    assert result[\"final_rating\"] == \"REVIEW\"\n+    # The model rating remains available as evidence.\n+    assert result[\"model_rating\"] == \"Buy\"\n+\n+\n+@pytest.mark.unit\n+def test_missing_trader_action_is_r6_unknown(tmp_path):\n+    \"\"\"[SAFETY] A missing Trader action is reflected by R6 (input integrity) UNKNOWN.\"\"\"\n+    from tradingagents.risk_gate.adapter import apply_gate\n+    result = apply_gate(\"NVDA\", \"2026-01-09\", None, _buy_decision(), RISK_PORTFOLIO,\n+                        audit_dir=tmp_path / \"audit\")\n+    outcomes = {r.rule_id: str(r.outcome) for r in result[\"risk_evaluation\"].rule_results}\n+    assert outcomes.get(\"R6_INPUT_INTEGRITY\") == \"UNKNOWN\", outcomes\n+\n+\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+# 3. Malformed risk_portfolio handling\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+\n+\n+@pytest.mark.unit\n+@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"bad\", [\n+    \"not-a-dict\",\n+    42,\n+    [\"list\", \"not\", \"dict\"],\n+], ids=[\"str\", \"int\", \"list\"])\n+def test_non_dict_risk_portfolio_never_actionable(bad, tmp_path):\n+    \"\"\"[SAFETY] A non-dict risk_portfolio never yields an ACTIONABLE result.\"\"\"\n+    from tradingagents.risk_gate.adapter import apply_gate\n+    try:\n+        result = apply_gate(\"NVDA\", \"2026-01-09\", _buy_proposal(), _buy_decision(), bad,\n+                            audit_dir=tmp_path / \"audit\")\n+    except Exception:\n+        return  # explicit fail-closed is acceptable; never ACTIONABLE\n+    assert result[\"decision_status\"] != \"ACTIONABLE\", result\n+\n+\n+@pytest.mark.unit\n+@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"snapshot\", [\n+    {\"portfolio_value\": \"not-a-number\", \"cash\": 1.0, \"valuation_date\": \"2026-01-09\", \"holdings\": []},\n+    {\"portfolio_value\": 100.0, \"cash\": 1.0, \"valuation_date\": \"2026-01-09\",\n+     \"holdings\": [{\"ticker\": \"NVDA\", \"market_value\": \"x\", \"sector\": \"Technology\"}]},\n+    {\"cash\": 1.0},  # missing portfolio_value/valuation_date\n+], ids=[\"bad_value_type\", \"bad_market_value\", \"missing_fields\"])\n+def test_invalid_snapshot_schema_never_actionable(snapshot, tmp_path):\n+    \"\"\"[SAFETY] An invalid snapshot schema yields NEEDS_REVIEW or a fail-closed\n+    exception, never ACTIONABLE.\"\"\"\n+    from tradingagents.risk_gate.adapter import apply_gate\n+    rp = {\"snapshot\": snapshot, \"target_position\": {\"target_position_weight\": 0.05,\n+                                                    \"sector\": \"Technology\"}}\n+    try:\n+        result = apply_gate(\"NVDA\", \"2026-01-09\", _buy_proposal(), _buy_decision(), rp,\n+                            audit_dir=tmp_path / \"audit\")\n+    except Exception:\n+        return\n+    assert result[\"risk_verdict\"] != \"APPROVED\"\n+    assert result[\"decision_status\"] != \"ACTIONABLE\"\n+\n+\n+@pytest.mark.unit\n+@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"target\", [\n+    {\"target_position_weight\": \"half\", \"sector\": \"Technology\"},\n+    {\"target_position_weight\": -0.1, \"sector\": \"Technology\"},\n+    {\"target_position_weight\": 2.0, \"sector\": \"Technology\"},\n+    \"not-a-dict\",\n+], ids=[\"bad_str\", \"negative\", \"over_one\", \"not_dict\"])\n+def test_malformed_target_position_never_actionable(target, tmp_path):\n+    \"\"\"[SAFETY] A malformed target_position never yields an ACTIONABLE result.\"\"\"\n+    from tradingagents.risk_gate.adapter import apply_gate\n+    rp = {\"snapshot\": RISK_PORTFOLIO[\"snapshot\"], \"target_position\": target}\n+    try:\n+        result = apply_gate(\"NVDA\", \"2026-01-09\", _buy_proposal(), _buy_decision(), rp,\n+                            audit_dir=tmp_path / \"audit\")\n+    except Exception:\n+        return\n+    assert result[\"risk_verdict\"] != \"APPROVED\"\n+    assert result[\"decision_status\"] != \"ACTIONABLE\"\n",
        "additions": 183,
        "deletions": 0,
        "status": "added"
      },

        "patch": "Index: tests/risk_gate/test_integration_retention.py\n===================================================================\n--- tests/risk_gate/test_integration_retention.py\t\n+++ tests/risk_gate/test_integration_retention.py\t\n@@ -1,401 +1,407 @@\n \"\"\"Integration acceptance: structured retention, audit persistence, downstream\n consumers, checkpoint safety, and performance (FR-A1 §5.1, §5.5, §13).\n \n [SAFETY] The gate reads structured objects without re-parsing Markdown; the audit\n is persisted with the exposure inputs; blocked BUYs are not authorized downstream;\n a pre-gate checkpoint re-evaluates on resume.\n [PRESERVE] Rendered strings keep their baseline shape.\n \n These run the **real graph** with the offline scripted model and the real engine.\n Before integration coding the adapter/state keys are absent, so they fail (RED).\n \"\"\"\n \n from __future__ import annotations\n \n import json\n import time\n \n import pytest\n \n import tests.test_graph_end_to_end as e2e\n from tests.risk_gate.test_decision_boundary import (\n     RISK_PORTFOLIO,\n     _buy_decision,\n     _buy_proposal,\n     _graph,\n )\n \n \n @pytest.fixture\n def offline(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n     return e2e.offline.__wrapped__(monkeypatch, tmp_path)\n \n \n def _state_log(graph, ticker=\"NVDA\"):\n     from pathlib import Path\n \n     logs = sorted(Path(graph.config[\"results_dir\"]).glob(\n         f\"{ticker}/TradingAgentsStrategy_logs/*.json\"))\n     assert logs, \"no state log written\"\n     return json.loads(logs[-1].read_text())\n \n \n # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n # C. Structured data retention\n # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n \n \n @pytest.mark.unit\n def test_both_structured_objects_reach_the_gate(tmp_path, monkeypatch, offline):\n     \"\"\"[SAFETY] Trader and PM structured objects are retained in state for the gate.\"\"\"\n     graph = _graph(tmp_path, monkeypatch, _buy_proposal(), _buy_decision(),\n                    risk_portfolio=RISK_PORTFOLIO)\n     state, _ = graph.propagate(\"NVDA\", e2e.TRADE_DATE)\n \n     assert state.get(\"trader_proposal\") is not None\n     assert state.get(\"portfolio_decision\") is not None\n     assert state[\"trader_proposal\"].action.value == \"Buy\"\n     assert state[\"portfolio_decision\"].rating.value == \"Buy\"\n \n \n @pytest.mark.unit\n def test_free_text_fallback_cannot_bypass_required_inputs(tmp_path, monkeypatch, offline):\n     \"\"\"[SAFETY] A non-structured run (no typed proposals) cannot be approved.\"\"\"\n     # structured=False -> the model never returns typed objects; the gate has no\n     # structured inputs and must fail closed.\n     graph = e2e._graph(tmp_path, monkeypatch, e2e.ScriptedModel(structured=False),\n                        risk_portfolio=RISK_PORTFOLIO)\n     state, signal = graph.propagate(\"NVDA\", e2e.TRADE_DATE)\n \n     assert state.get(\"risk_verdict\") in (\"NEEDS_REVIEW\", \"REJECTED\")\n     assert signal == \"REVIEW\"\n     assert state.get(\"decision_status\") != \"ACTIONABLE\"\n \n \n @pytest.mark.unit\n def test_validation_failure_is_non_actionable_with_audit(tmp_path, monkeypatch, offline):\n     \"\"\"[SAFETY] A validation failure yields a non-actionable result with an audit record.\"\"\"\n     graph = _graph(tmp_path, monkeypatch, _buy_proposal(stop_loss=None), _buy_decision(),\n                    risk_portfolio=RISK_PORTFOLIO)\n     state, _ = graph.propagate(\"NVDA\", e2e.TRADE_DATE)\n \n     assert state[\"decision_status\"] in (\"BLOCKED\", \"PENDING_REVIEW\")\n     audit = state.get(\"risk_evaluation\")\n     assert audit is not None\n     assert audit.rule_results\n \n \n # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n # D. Audit persistence\n # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n \n \n @pytest.mark.unit\n def test_audit_persisted_with_required_fields(tmp_path, monkeypatch, offline):\n     \"\"\"[NFR-A2] State log records rule ids/outcomes, snapshot, verdict, policy, UTC.\"\"\"\n     graph = _graph(tmp_path, monkeypatch, _buy_proposal(), _buy_decision(),\n                    risk_portfolio=RISK_PORTFOLIO)\n     graph.propagate(\"NVDA\", e2e.TRADE_DATE)\n     entry = _state_log(graph)\n \n     audit = entry.get(\"risk_audit\") or entry.get(\"risk_evaluation\")\n     assert audit is not None, \"audit not persisted\"\n     assert entry.get(\"risk_verdict\") == \"APPROVED\"\n     assert audit[\"policy_version\"] == \"fr-a1-v1\"\n     assert audit[\"policy_hash\"]\n     assert audit[\"evaluated_at_utc\"].endswith(\"Z\")\n     assert audit[\"rule_results\"] and all(\"rule_id\" in r and \"outcome\" in r\n                                          for r in audit[\"rule_results\"])\n     assert audit[\"input_snapshot\"]\n \n \n @pytest.mark.unit\n def test_audit_snapshot_includes_numeric_exposure_inputs(tmp_path, monkeypatch, offline):\n     \"\"\"[§5.3] The audit exposes the numbers that explain sector/position math.\"\"\"\n     graph = _graph(tmp_path, monkeypatch, _buy_proposal(), _buy_decision(),\n                    risk_portfolio=RISK_PORTFOLIO)\n     graph.propagate(\"NVDA\", e2e.TRADE_DATE)\n     entry = _state_log(graph)\n     audit = entry.get(\"risk_audit\") or entry.get(\"risk_evaluation\")\n     snap = audit[\"input_snapshot\"]\n \n     for key in (\"target_position_weight\", \"portfolio_value\", \"cash\", \"target_sector\"):\n         assert key in snap, key\n     assert snap[\"target_position_weight\"] == 0.05\n \n \n @pytest.mark.unit\n def test_audit_has_no_credentials_or_prompts(tmp_path, monkeypatch, offline):\n     \"\"\"[NFR-SEC] The persisted audit stores no credentials or raw prompts.\"\"\"\n     graph = _graph(tmp_path, monkeypatch, _buy_proposal(), _buy_decision(),\n                    risk_portfolio=RISK_PORTFOLIO)\n     graph.propagate(\"NVDA\", e2e.TRADE_DATE)\n     entry = _state_log(graph)\n     assert entry.get(\"risk_audit\") or entry.get(\"risk_evaluation\"), \"audit not persisted\"\n     blob = json.dumps(entry).lower()\n     for needle in (\"api_key\", \"apikey\", \"secret\", \"password\", \"bearer\", \"authorization\"):\n         assert needle not in blob\n     assert \"prompt\" not in blob\n \n \n @pytest.mark.unit\n @pytest.mark.parametrize(\"label, proposal, decision\", [\n     (\"approved\", _buy_proposal(), _buy_decision()),\n     (\"rejected\", _buy_proposal(stop_loss=None), _buy_decision()),\n     (\"needs_review\", _buy_proposal(), _buy_decision(price_target=None)),\n ])\n def test_all_verdicts_are_audited(tmp_path, monkeypatch, offline, label, proposal, decision):\n     \"\"\"[NFR-A2] APPROVED, REJECTED and NEEDS_REVIEW all produce an audit record.\"\"\"\n     graph = _graph(tmp_path, monkeypatch, proposal, decision, risk_portfolio=RISK_PORTFOLIO)\n     state, _ = graph.propagate(\"NVDA\", e2e.TRADE_DATE)\n     assert state.get(\"risk_evaluation\") is not None\n     assert _state_log(graph).get(\"risk_verdict\") == state[\"risk_verdict\"]\n \n \n @pytest.mark.unit\n def test_audit_persistence_failure_cannot_leave_actionable_signal(tmp_path, monkeypatch, offline):\n     \"\"\"[SAFETY] If audit persistence fails, an actionable signal must not stand.\"\"\"\n     graph = _graph(tmp_path, monkeypatch, _buy_proposal(), _buy_decision(),\n                    risk_portfolio=RISK_PORTFOLIO)\n \n     def boom(*a, **k):\n         raise OSError(\"disk full\")\n \n     monkeypatch.setattr(graph, \"_log_state\", boom)\n     with pytest.raises(OSError):\n         graph.propagate(\"NVDA\", e2e.TRADE_DATE)\n \n \n @pytest.mark.unit\n def test_audit_failure_does_not_release_actionable_buy_on_stream(tmp_path, monkeypatch, offline):\n     \"\"\"[SAFETY] A durable-audit failure must not publish an actionable BUY.\n \n     The approved boundary (ADR §14): **every** risk evaluation must establish its\n     required durable audit before the Portfolio Manager publishes its effective\n     final recommendation. If persistence fails, the recommendation must not be\n     published as actionable.\n \n     The Stage 2 adapter defines the durable writer ``risk_gate.adapter.persist_audit``.\n     We patch that *actual* writer with ``raising=True`` (so a missing writer fails\n     this test RED), record that it was invoked, and make it raise a real\n     persistence error. The test then proves no actionable BUY is released: it must\n     either raise closed, or never stream ``final_rating == \"Buy\"``.\n     \"\"\"\n     from tradingagents.risk_gate import adapter\n \n     calls = {\"n\": 0}\n \n     def failing_writer(*a, **k):\n         calls[\"n\"] += 1\n         raise OSError(\"audit store unavailable\")\n \n     # raises if the writer is absent -> RED before implementation.\n     monkeypatch.setattr(adapter, \"persist_audit\", failing_writer, raising=True)\n \n     graph = _graph(tmp_path, monkeypatch, _buy_proposal(), _buy_decision(),\n                    risk_portfolio=RISK_PORTFOLIO)\n \n     released = []\n     closed = False\n     try:\n         for _messages, chunk in graph.stream_run(\n                 graph.create_run_state(\"NVDA\", e2e.TRADE_DATE), **graph.propagator.get_graph_args()):\n             if chunk and \"final_rating\" in chunk:\n                 released.append((chunk.get(\"final_rating\"), chunk.get(\"risk_verdict\")))\n     except OSError:\n         closed = True\n \n     # The failure injection must actually have executed.\n     assert calls[\"n\"] >= 1, \"durable audit writer was never invoked; injection unused\"\n     # Safety: no actionable BUY may be published when persistence failed.\n     for rating, verdict in released:\n         assert not (rating == \"Buy\" and verdict == \"APPROVED\"), released\n     if not closed:\n         # If the run did not fail closed, it must not have approved anything.\n         assert all(verdict != \"APPROVED\" for _rating, verdict in released), released\n \n \n # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n # E. Downstream consumers (reports, memory, model evidence)\n # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n \n \n @pytest.mark.unit\n def test_model_recommendation_preserved_as_evidence(tmp_path, monkeypatch, offline):\n     \"\"\"[SAFETY] The model rating is preserved and distinguishable from the signal.\"\"\"\n     graph = _graph(tmp_path, monkeypatch, _buy_proposal(stop_loss=None), _buy_decision(),\n                    risk_portfolio=RISK_PORTFOLIO)\n     state, signal = graph.propagate(\"NVDA\", e2e.TRADE_DATE)\n \n     assert state[\"model_rating\"] == \"Buy\"        # evidence\n     assert signal == \"REVIEW\"                    # effective public signal\n     assert state[\"model_rating\"] != signal\n \n \n @pytest.mark.unit\n def test_blocked_buy_is_not_an_authorized_buy_in_report(tmp_path, monkeypatch, offline):\n     \"\"\"[SAFETY] A blocked BUY does not appear as an authorized BUY in the report header.\"\"\"\n     from tradingagents.reporting import write_report_tree\n \n     graph = _graph(tmp_path, monkeypatch, _buy_proposal(stop_loss=None), _buy_decision(),\n                    risk_portfolio=RISK_PORTFOLIO)\n     state, _ = graph.propagate(\"NVDA\", e2e.TRADE_DATE)\n     report = write_report_tree(state, \"NVDA\", tmp_path / \"report\").read_text()\n \n     assert \"- Rating: REVIEW\" in report\n     assert \"- Rating: Buy\" not in report\n \n \n @pytest.mark.unit\n def test_blocked_buy_memory_rating_is_review(tmp_path, monkeypatch, offline):\n     \"\"\"[SAFETY] The memory log does not record a blocked BUY as a Buy position.\"\"\"\n     graph = _graph(tmp_path, monkeypatch, _buy_proposal(stop_loss=None), _buy_decision(),\n                    risk_portfolio=RISK_PORTFOLIO)\n     graph.propagate(\"NVDA\", e2e.TRADE_DATE)\n     entries = [e for e in graph.memory_log.load_entries() if e[\"ticker\"] == \"NVDA\"]\n     assert entries, \"no memory entry recorded\"\n     assert entries[-1][\"rating\"] == \"REVIEW\"\n \n \n @pytest.mark.unit\n def test_rendered_strings_unchanged(tmp_path, monkeypatch, offline):\n     \"\"\"[PRESERVE] Rendered Markdown for reports/memory keeps its baseline shape.\"\"\"\n     from tradingagents.agents.schemas import render_pm_decision, render_trader_proposal\n \n     graph = _graph(tmp_path, monkeypatch, _buy_proposal(), _buy_decision(),\n                    risk_portfolio=RISK_PORTFOLIO)\n     state, _ = graph.propagate(\"NVDA\", e2e.TRADE_DATE)\n \n     assert render_trader_proposal(state[\"trader_proposal\"]) == state[\"trader_investment_plan\"]\n     assert render_pm_decision(state[\"portfolio_decision\"]) == state[\"final_trade_decision\"]\n \n \n \n # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n # F. Checkpoint safety (actual resume + legacy-signature compatibility)\n # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n \n \n @pytest.mark.unit\n def test_pre_gate_checkpoint_resumes_through_evaluation(tmp_path, monkeypatch, offline):\n     \"\"\"[SAFETY] A checkpoint created before the gate re-evaluates on resume.\n \n     The graph is interrupted before the Portfolio Manager, checkpointing enabled;\n     the resumed run must reach the gate and produce a verdict (not bypass it).\n     \"\"\"\n     model = e2e.ScriptedModel(structured=True, fail_at=12)   # before the decision\n     graph = e2e._graph(tmp_path, monkeypatch, model, checkpoint_enabled=True,\n                        risk_portfolio=RISK_PORTFOLIO)\n     with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match=\"provider unavailable\"):\n         graph.propagate(\"NVDA\", e2e.TRADE_DATE)\n \n     state, signal = graph.propagate(\"NVDA\", e2e.TRADE_DATE)\n \n     assert \"risk_verdict\" in state\n     assert state[\"risk_verdict\"] in (\"APPROVED\", \"REJECTED\", \"NEEDS_REVIEW\")\n     assert signal == state.get(\"final_rating\")\n \n \n @pytest.mark.unit\n def test_legacy_pre_gate_checkpoint_cannot_bypass_evaluation(tmp_path, monkeypatch, offline):\n     \"\"\"[SAFETY] A real checkpoint written under the legacy (pre-gate) signature is\n     retrievable under that thread, but the gated graph uses a distinct signature and\n     cannot retrieve it, so it starts fresh and evaluates risk.\n \n     Uses the repository's real ``thread_id`` / ``get_checkpointer`` /\n     ``checkpoint_step`` APIs. Not a substring check on a hash.\n     \"\"\"\n     from tradingagents.graph.checkpointer import checkpoint_step, get_checkpointer, thread_id\n \n     graph = e2e._graph(tmp_path, monkeypatch, e2e.ScriptedModel(structured=True),\n                        checkpoint_enabled=True)\n     gated_sig = graph._run_signature(\"stock\", None)\n \n     # The legacy signature is the pre-gate run signature: its markers without the\n     # gate's own marker. After integration the gated signature differs from it; the\n     # test fails RED until the gate adds its marker.\n     legacy_sig = \"|\".join(p for p in gated_sig.split(\"|\") if not p.startswith(\"risk_gate\"))\n \n     cache = graph.config[\"data_cache_dir\"]\n     legacy_tid = thread_id(\"NVDA\", e2e.TRADE_DATE, legacy_sig)\n     gated_tid = thread_id(\"NVDA\", e2e.TRADE_DATE, gated_sig)\n \n     # Write a real checkpoint under the legacy thread via the real saver.\n     from langgraph.graph import END, START, StateGraph\n \n     with get_checkpointer(cache, \"NVDA\") as saver:\n         g = StateGraph(dict)\n         g.add_node(\"noop\", lambda s: {})\n         g.add_edge(START, \"noop\")\n         g.add_edge(\"noop\", END)\n         compiled = g.compile(checkpointer=saver)\n         compiled.invoke({}, config={\"configurable\": {\"thread_id\": legacy_tid}})\n         # Prove the legacy checkpoint is actually written and retrievable.\n         assert saver.get_tuple({\"configurable\": {\"thread_id\": legacy_tid}}) is not None\n         assert saver.get_tuple({\"configurable\": {\"thread_id\": gated_tid}}) is None\n \n     # The legacy checkpoint is retrievable under its own signature.\n     assert checkpoint_step(cache, \"NVDA\", e2e.TRADE_DATE, legacy_sig) is not None\n     # The gated signature is distinct and cannot retrieve the legacy record.\n     assert gated_sig != legacy_sig\n     assert gated_tid != legacy_tid\n     assert checkpoint_step(cache, \"NVDA\", e2e.TRADE_DATE, gated_sig) is None\n \n     # The gated graph therefore starts fresh and evaluates risk before deciding.\n     state, _ = graph.propagate(\"NVDA\", e2e.TRADE_DATE)\n     assert state.get(\"risk_verdict\") in (\"APPROVED\", \"REJECTED\", \"NEEDS_REVIEW\")\n     assert state.get(\"risk_evaluation\") is not None\n \n \n # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n # G. def persist_audit(evaluation: RiskEvaluation, audit_dir=None):
````
```text
    """Durable audit writer. Writes one JSON record per evaluation when a directory
    is given; otherwise returns the payload without touching disk (used for the
    in-memory benchmark). Returns the serialisable payload.

    This is the real function the production integration calls for every
    evaluation, and the one the durable-audit-failure test patches.
    """
    payload = _audit_payload(evaluation)
    if audit_dir is not None:
        directory = Path(audit_dir)
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        ticker = safe_ticker_component(str(evaluation.input_snapshot.get("ticker", "unknown")))
        stamp = evaluation.evaluated_at_utc.replace(":", "").replace(".", "").replace("-", "")
        path = directory / f"risk_audit_{ticker}_{stamp}.json"
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(payload, f, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False)
    return payload
```

```text
def build_inputs(ticker, trade_date, trader_proposal, portfolio_decision, risk_portfolio=None):
    """Public: convert structured inputs into ``RiskInputs`` without evaluating."""
    return _build_inputs_core(ticker, trade_date, trader_proposal, portfolio_decision, risk_portfolio)


def _effective_rating(evaluation: RiskEvaluation) -> str:
    """The effective public rating: the model rating only when APPROVED and
    actionable; otherwise the REVIEW sentinel."""
    if evaluation.verdict == "APPROVED" and evaluation.decision_status == "ACTIONABLE":
        return evaluation.model_rating or RATING_REVIEW
    return RATING_REVIEW


def apply_gate(ticker, trade_date, trader_proposal, portfolio_decision, risk_portfolio=None,
               *, policy=None, audit_dir=None):
    """Evaluate once, persist the durable audit, and return the state updates.

    Returns a dict with ``model_rating``, ``final_rating`` (effective),
    ``risk_verdict``, ``decision_status`` and ``risk_evaluation`` (the
    :class:`RiskEvaluation`). The durable audit is written before an actionable
    rating is returned; if persistence raises, this function propagates the
    failure so no actionable rating is published.
    """
    inputs = _build_inputs_core(ticker, trade_date, trader_proposal, portfolio_decision,
                                risk_portfolio)
    evaluation = evaluate_risk(inputs, policy)

    # Durable audit must be established before an actionable rating can be published.
    persist_audit(evaluation, audit_dir)

    return {
        "model_rating": evaluation.model_rating,
        "final_rating": _effective_rating(evaluation),
        "risk_verdict": str(evaluation.verdict),
        "decision_status": str(evaluation.decision_status),
        "risk_evaluation": evaluation,
    }
```

```text
Now I understand the current gaps precisely:
- **Gap 1:** `persist_audit(..., audit_dir=None)` returns without writing → an APPROVED decision can be published with no durable file. `apply_gate` doesn't enforce a destination.
- **Gap 2:** `trader_proposal=None` → `action=None`; but `model_rating="Buy"` supplies direction ("long"), so R1/R2/R3/R4 evaluate against `entry_price=None` etc. → R1 VIOLATED/UNKNOWN. Need to confirm it can't APPROVE.
- **Gap 3:** `risk_portfolio.get(...)` assumes dict → non-dict raises `AttributeError` (not caught), `model_validate` raises `ValidationError`. Need graceful NEEDS_REVIEW or explicit fail-closed, never ACTIONABLE.

I'll write the tests (RED where the production defect exists), update the perf test, and migrate the 6 baseline assertions. Let me first check the six baseline assertions.
```

```text
@pytest.mark.unit
@pytest.mark.parametrize("structured", [False, True], ids=["free-text", "structured"])
def test_a_full_run_reaches_a_logged_decision(tmp_path, monkeypatch, offline, structured):
    graph = _graph(tmp_path, monkeypatch, ScriptedModel(structured=structured))

    state, signal = graph.propagate("NVDA", TRADE_DATE)

    assert signal == state["final_rating"] == "Overweight"
    for key in ("market_report", "sentiment_report", "news_report", "fundamentals_report",
                "investment_plan", "trader_investment_plan", "final_trade_decision"):
        assert state[key].strip(), key
    tool_methods = {"get_stock_data", "get_indicators", "get_news", "get_global_news",
                    "get_macro_indicators", "get_prediction_markets", "get_fundamentals",
                    "get_balance_sheet", "get_cashflow", "get_income_statement",
                    "get_insider_transactions", "ohlcv"}
    assert offline == tool_methods
    assert [e["rating"] for e in graph.memory_log.load_entries()] == ["Overweight"]


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_an_interrupted_run_resumes_from_its_checkpoint(tmp_path, monkeypatch, offline):
    model = ScriptedModel(fail_at=12)            # past the analysts, before the decision
    graph = _graph(tmp_path, monkeypatch, model, checkpoint_enabled=True)
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="provider unavailable"):
        graph.propagate("NVDA", TRADE_DATE)
    calls_before = len(model.calls)

    _, signal = graph.propagate("NVDA", TRADE_DATE)

    assert signal == "Overweight"
    resumed_calls = len(model.calls) - calls_before
    full_run = ScriptedModel()
    _graph(tmp_path / "fresh", monkeypatch, full_run).propagate("NVDA", TRADE_DATE)
    # The resumed run makes only the calls the interrupted one had not completed.
    assert resumed_calls == len(full_run.calls) - (model.fail_at - 1)
```

```text
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# G. Actual integration overhead (adapter conversion + evaluation + audit)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _bench_adapter(iterations=200):
    """Measure the adapter's per-call overhead: input conversion + evaluation +
    audit construction, over repeated offline runs. Returns (p50, p95) in ms."""
    from tradingagents.risk_gate.adapter import apply_gate

    tp = _buy_proposal()
    pd = _buy_decision()
    samples = []
    for _ in range(iterations):
        start = time.perf_counter()
        apply_gate("NVDA", e2e.TRADE_DATE, tp, pd, RISK_PORTFOLIO)
        samples.append((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000.0)
    samples.sort()
    p50 = samples[len(samples) // 2]
    p95 = samples[int(0.95 * (len(samples) - 1))]
    return p50, p95


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_actual_adapter_overhead_p95_within_two_seconds():
    """[NFR-A1] The real gate-added overhead (adapter+evaluation+audit) p95 <= 2000 ms."""
    p50, p95 = _bench_adapter(iterations=200)
    print(f"\nrisk-gate adapter overhead: p50={p50:.4f}ms p95={p95:.4f}ms n=200")
    assert p95 <= 2000.0, f"adapter p95={p95:.4f}ms exceeds 2000ms"



```

```text
@pytest.mark.unit
def test_a_debug_run_prints_the_analysts_work_and_reaches_the_same_decision(tmp_path, monkeypatch, offline, capsys):
    """Debug mode streams the analysts' own graphs, so their tool calls still print."""
    graph = _graph(tmp_path, monkeypatch, ScriptedModel(), debug=True)

    state, signal = graph.propagate("NVDA", TRADE_DATE)

    assert signal == "Overweight"
    assert state["market_report"].strip() and state["fundamentals_report"].strip()
    printed = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert "get_stock_data" in printed and "get_balance_sheet" in printed


@pytest.mark.unit

@pytest.mark.unit
def test_an_analyst_that_keeps_calling_tools_writes_its_report_at_the_limit(tmp_path, monkeypatch, offline):
    """A model that does not stop calling tools must not end the run (#1420)."""
    model = LoopingModel(structured=True)
    graph = _graph(tmp_path, monkeypatch, model, max_tool_rounds=3)

    final_state, rating = graph.propagate("NVDA", TRADE_DATE)

    assert len(model.tool_turns) == 3 * 3   # three tool-using analysts, three rounds each
    for key in ("market_report", "news_report", "fundamentals_report"):
        assert final_state[key] == TEXT
    assert rating == "Overweight"


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_the_last_turn_is_offered_no_tools_and_reads_its_tool_results_as_text(tmp_path, monkeypatch, offline):
    """Offered tools, a model may call one whatever it is told; a history holding
    tool calls may be refused by a provider when no tools are bound."""
    model = LoopingModel(structured=True)
    graph = _graph(tmp_path, monkeypatch, model, max_tool_rounds=2)
===
    from tradingagents.reporting import write_report_tree

    graph = _graph(tmp_path, monkeypatch, ScriptedModel(structured=True))

    def locked():
        raise OSError("memory log is locked")

    monkeypatch.setattr(graph, "settle_all_pending", locked)
    final_state, rating = graph.propagate("NVDA", TRADE_DATE)

    assert rating == "Overweight"
    assert "could not be settled" in final_state["memory_note"]
    report = write_report_tree(final_state, "NVDA", tmp_path / "report").read_text()
    assert "Memory log: Past decisions could not be settled" in report


@pytest.mark.unit
```

```json
{
```
```json
  "command": "cd <workspace>/code/CS5351/TradingAgents-team-FR-A1 && cat >> docs/architecture/adr/adr-fr-a1-risk-gate.md <<'EOF'\n\n## 15. Stage 2 final safety review: durable destination, missing action, malformed inputs\n\nSource review of the Stage 2 implementation found three gaps; this section records\nthe required contract (verified test-first in `tests/risk_gate/test_adapter_safety.py`).\n\n### 15.1 Durable audit destination is mandatory for ACTIONABLE output\n\n`persist_audit(evaluation, audit_dir=None)` returning an in-memory payload is **not**\na durable audit. The approved contract (extends §14):\n\n- An `APPROVED`/`ACTIONABLE` recommendation may be published **only** if a real\n  durable audit record was written to disk before publication.\n- A missing (`None`) or unusable audit destination must **not** silently bypass\n  persistence: the decision must not be `ACTIONABLE` (fail closed by raising is\n  acceptable).\n- The rule applies to **every** evaluated decision, not just rejected ones; an\n  `APPROVED` decision must have an actual persisted audit file.\n\nConsequence: `apply_gate` must treat the audit destination as required for an\nactionable result — either the caller supplies a writable `audit_dir`, or the\nresult is not actionable. The PM boundary always supplies the run's\n`results_dir/<ticker>/risk_audit`.\n\n### 15.2 A valid PortfolioDecision rating does not substitute for a missing Trader action\n\nWhen `trader_proposal` is `None` (or its action is missing/invalid), a valid PM\nrating must **not** supply the trade direction on its own:\n\n- The result must not be `APPROVED` or `ACTIONABLE`.\n- R6 input integrity must record the uncertainty (UNKNOWN), not PASS.\n- The model rating remains available in `model_rating` as evidence.\n\nThis refines the R6 semantics in §5.2 and the adapter contract in §13.3: an\nunusable Trader action is an input-integrity gap even when the PM rating is valid.\n\n### 15.3 Malformed `risk_portfolio` handling\n\nCaller inputs are never trusted or invented. For non-dict `risk_portfolio`, invalid\nsnapshot schema/numeric fields, or malformed `target_position`:\n\n- Prefer an auditable `NEEDS_REVIEW` when a safe evaluation can be constructed.\n- An explicit fail-closed exception is acceptable where safe evaluation or audit\n  persistence is impossible.\n- The result must **never** be `ACTIONABLE`.\n\n### 15.4 Baseline contract migration (approved)\n\nThe six `tests/test_graph_end_to_end.py` assertions that expected the old model\nrating (`Overweight`) for runs **without** `risk_portfolio` are migrated to the\napproved fail-closed effective signal `REVIEW`. Unrelated assertions (graph\ncompletion, checkpoint recovery, state logs, memory, rendered decisions, agent\nexecution) are preserved; where structured data exists the original model rating is\nverified separately via `model_rating`. This is an intentional, human-approved\nbehavior change, not a regression.\n\n### 15.5 Implementation status\n\nThe durable-destination rule (§15.1) and the missing-action R6 rule (§15.2) are\ncurrently **RED** in `test_adapter_safety.py` and await a production fix in a later\napproved turn. Tests were written first; no production code changed in this turn.\nEOF\necho done"
}
```

````text
Confirmed: the production files were left uncommitted from the prior implementation turn (baseline commits are only tests). This turn I added no production changes. Report below.

# FR-A1 Stage 2 — Final Safety & Regression Review: Test-First Corrections

Scope respected: **tests and FR-A1 docs only** this turn. No production code modified (the production diffs in `git status` are the prior turn's uncommitted Stage 2 implementation, untouched now).

## Test changes made

**New file `tests/risk_gate/test_adapter_safety.py`** (17 tests) — gaps 1–3:
- **Gap 1 (durable audit destination, 5 tests):** APPROVED without `audit_dir` must not be ACTIONABLE; unusable audit dir cannot bypass; APPROVED persists a real audit file before publication; failing writer blocks actionable output; ordinary valid path still approves.
- **Gap 2 (missing Trader action, 2 tests):** `trader_proposal=None` cannot be APPROVED/ACTIONABLE; missing action is R6 UNKNOWN while `model_rating` is preserved.
- **Gap 3 (malformed risk_portfolio, 10 tests):** non-dict `risk_portfolio` (str/int/list), invalid snapshot schema/numeric fields, malformed `target_position` (bad str/negative/>1/not-dict) — each never ACTIONABLE; explicit fail-closed exception accepted.

**Gap 4 (perf):** `test_actual_adapter_overhead_p95_within_two_seconds` now passes a real temporary `audit_dir`, measures conversion + one evaluation + durable write, asserts a file was written, p95 ≤ 2000 ms. Pure-core benchmark untouched.

**Gap 5 (baseline migration, `tests/test_graph_end_to_end.py`):** six assertions migrated from the old model rating (`Overweight`) to the approved fail-closed effective signal `REVIEW` for runs without `risk_portfolio`; where structured data exists, `model_rating == "Overweight"` is now verified separately. All unrelated assertions (graph completion, checkpoint recovery, state logs, memory, rendered decisions, agent execution, tool calls) preserved. Memory-rating assertion updated to `["REVIEW"]` (effective signal).

**Docs:** ADR §15 (durable destination mandatory, missing-action R6 rule, malformed-input handling, baseline migration, implementation status) and test plan §10.

## Verification (actual exit codes)
| Command | Exit | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `ruff check tests/risk_gate tests/test_graph_end_to_end.py` | **0** | All checks passed |
| `pytest tests/risk_gate/test_adapter_safety.py` | **1** | **2 failed, 15 passed** |
| perf test (audit-inclusive) | **0** | p50=0.2082 ms, p95=0.4234 ms, n=200 (file written) |
| `pytest tests/risk_gate` | **1** | **2 failed, 237 passed, 1 xpassed** |
| `pytest -q --ignore=tests/risk_gate` | **0** | **1412 passed, 1 skipped** (post-migration) |

## Classification
1. **Expected RED from newly discovered defects (2):**
   - `test_approved_without_audit_destination_is_never_actionable` — **Gap 1 confirmed**: valid BUY with `audit_dir=None` returns APPROVED/ACTIONABLE with no durable audit.
   - `test_missing_trader_action_is_r6_unknown` — **Gap 2 confirmed**: with `trader_proposal=None`, the valid PM rating supplies direction; the gate rejects (R1 VIOLATED) but **R6 records PASS, not UNKNOWN**, so the missing Trader action is not reflected as an integrity gap.
2. **Intentional baseline test-contract changes:** the six `test_graph_end_to_end.py` assertions migrated to the approved `REVIEW` fail-closed signal; model rating preserved via `model_rating` where structured.
3. **Unexpected regressions:** none — original suite 1412 passed after migration.
4. **Test harness errors:** none this turn (the prior CLI `_Buffer` harness fix remains in `test_decision_boundary.py`, unchanged here).

## Remaining RED tests
2 (both confirmed genuine defects pending a production fix in a later approved turn, per §15.5).
````

```text
I authorize exactly two targeted safety fixes.

## FIX 1 — Mandatory durable audit destination

Confirmed defect:
apply_gate(..., audit_dir=None) can currently return
APPROVED/ACTIONABLE without a durable audit file.

Required behavior:

- No actionable recommendation may be published
  without successful required audit persistence.
- A missing audit_dir must not silently count as
  successful persistence.
- An unusable or unwritable audit destination must
  fail closed.
- For a valid audit directory, ordinary valid BUY
  must still be capable of APPROVED/ACTIONABLE.
- The audit writer must be invoked before the
  effective final_rating becomes publishable.
- Preserve the existing single-evaluation design.
- Do not invent a global fallback audit path.
- Preserve the existing audit fields and tests.

The production Portfolio Manager boundary must
supply a real audit destination.

If a standalone adapter call cannot persist its
audit, it may raise a clear fail-closed exception.

Avoid claiming crash durability beyond what the
actual file-writing implementation guarantees.

## FIX 2 — Missing Trader action is R6 UNKNOWN

Confirmed defect:
With trader_proposal=None and a valid final PM
rating, the engine currently records R6 PASS even
though the Trader action is unavailable.

Required behavior:

- A missing/unrecognized Trader action must cause
  R6 INPUT_INTEGRITY = UNKNOWN.
- It must not become APPROVED/ACTIONABLE.
- Preserve the original model_rating as evidence.
- Preserve contradictions between structured
  Trader and Portfolio Manager decisions.
- Preserve the final verdict precedence:
  REJECTED > NEEDS_REVIEW > APPROVED.
- An independent R1 violation may still make the
  overall verdict REJECTED.
- Do not substitute the PM rating for missing
  Trader authorization.

Apply the smallest appropriate change to the
core integrity check or adapter, without changing
other risk rules.
```

```text
    if term in _LONG:

    if term in _SHORT:
        return "short"
    if term in _HOLD:

    """Resolve the decision direction, consistency, and final-rating validity.
```

```text
def _direction_is_enforceable(direction, consistent: bool) -> bool:
    """Whether an actionable (long/short) trade is well-defined enough to be actionable."""
    return consistent and direction in ("long", "short")


def evaluate_risk(inputs: RiskInputs, policy: RiskPolicy | None = None) -> RiskEvaluation:
    """Evaluate one decision against the policy; return a complete, audited result."""
    policy = policy or RiskPolicy()
    started_wall = datetime.now(UTC)

    direction, consistent, rating_valid = _direction(inputs.action, inputs.model_rating)

    rule_results.append(_evaluate_sector(inputs, direction, policy))
```

```text
Now FIX 1: `apply_gate` must not return ACTIONABLE without a durable audit. I'll make `apply_gate` raise a clear fail-closed exception when the evaluation is APPROVED/ACTIONABLE but `audit_dir` is missing (or persistence didn't write). Also `persist_audit` should raise if `audit_dir is None`? No—the benchmark uses `audit_dir=None` but expects APPROVED... wait, the updated benchmark passes a real `audit_dir`. But `_bench_adapter` default `audit_dir=None`; the test passes a real dir now. However `test_ordinary_valid_audit_path_still_approves` uses a real dir. And `test_approved_without_audit_destination_is_never_actionable` expects non-actionable when `audit_dir=None`.

Design: in `apply_gate`, after `evaluate_risk`, if the result is APPROVED with ACTIONABLE status and no `audit_dir`, raise `AuditPersistenceError` (fail closed). Otherwise persist normally. For non-actionable verdicts, `audit_dir=None` may return payload (no durable requirement for publication since not actionable). Let me add a clear exception and enforce.
```

```text
Now the PM boundary: it may call `apply_gate` with `audit_dir=None` when `results_dir`/ticker are absent (e.g. unit-level state). If the result would be actionable, that now raises. To preserve graceful graph behavior, the PM should always supply a real audit dir when available; when not available, we must not crash the whole run with an uncaught exception but also must not publish actionable. Safest: catch `AuditPersistenceError` at the PM boundary and downgrade to a non-actionable REVIEW result (fail closed), preserving existing graph behavior. Let me check the PM boundary code.
```

```text
The approved spec says: "If a standalone adapter call cannot persist its audit, it may raise a clear fail-closed exception." But this test calls `_apply` directly and would propagate the raise instead of the assertion. The test was approved as-is and asserts a returned non-actionable result. I must not modify tests. Two compliant options:

1. Return a non-actionable result (downgrade) when `audit_dir is None` for actionable — rather than raising. This satisfies the test and the requirement ("No actionable recommendation may be published without successful audit persistence").

The spec permits either raising OR not-actionable; the committed test requires not-actionable (no exception). So I'll downgrade instead of raise: when actionable and no audit_dir, return a REVIEW/PENDING_REVIEW result and do not persist. Let me change `apply_gate`.

But `test_failing_audit_writer_blocks_actionable_output` expects `pytest.raises(OSError)` when the writer raises with a real `audit_dir` — that's separate and still holds. Let me adjust the no-destination case to downgrade.
```

````text
All done. This turn I modified only `engine.py`, `adapter.py`, and `portfolio_manager.py` (the PM boundary, permitted only as needed for the audit boundary). The other listed files (`state.py`, `trader.py`, `trading_graph.py`) are prior-turn implementation, unchanged now.

# FR-A1 Final Stage 2 Safety Fixes — Completion Report

## 1. Exact production changes (this turn)

**`tradingagents/risk_gate/engine.py` (FIX 2)**
- `_direction()` now also returns `action_valid` (Trader action is a recognized term), alongside `rating_valid`/`consistent`.
- `_evaluate_integrity()` takes `action_valid` and records **R6 INPUT_INTEGRITY = UNKNOWN** when the Trader action is missing/unrecognized — independent of, and before, direction checks. It does not substitute the PM rating for a missing Trader authorization. Contradiction handling (`consistent`) and precedence are unchanged; an independent R1 violation can still make the verdict REJECTED.

**`tradingagents/risk_gate/adapter.py` (FIX 1)**
- Added `AuditPersistenceError`.
- `apply_gate()` now treats a durable audit as mandatory for actionable output: if the evaluation would be `APPROVED`/`ACTIONABLE` and `audit_dir is None`, it does **not** publish ACTIONABLE — it returns a non-actionable result (`final_rating=REVIEW`, `NEEDS_REVIEW`, `PENDING_REVIEW`) and does not persist. Otherwise it calls `persist_audit` (which raises on an unwritable destination), before returning the effective rating. Single-evaluation design preserved; no global fallback path invented.

**`tradingagents/agents/managers/portfolio_manager.py` (boundary)**
- Supplies the real audit destination `results_dir/<ticker>/risk_audit`; defensively catches `AuditPersistenceError` and downgrades to a non-actionable REVIEW result rather than crashing the graph (fail-closed, preserves graph behavior). No other logic changed.

No tests, ADRs, thresholds, policy, CLI, reporting, memory, checkpoint, CI, or shared requirements modified.

## 2. Results for the two previously RED tests
- `test_approved_without_audit_destination_is_never_actionable` → **PASSED**
- `test_missing_trader_action_is_r6_unknown` → **PASSED**

## 3. Complete test results (exit codes)
| Command | Exit | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `ruff check …all listed files…` | **0** | All checks passed |
| `pytest tests/risk_gate/test_adapter_safety.py -v` | **0** | **17 passed** |
| `pytest tests/risk_gate/test_decision_boundary.py tests/risk_gate/test_integration_retention.py -q` | **0** | **27 passed** |
| `pytest tests/risk_gate -q` | **0** | **239 passed, 1 xpassed** (documented P2) |
| `pytest -q --ignore=tests/risk_gate` | **0** | **1412 passed, 1 skipped, 1 deselected** |

Explicit checks: 100 invalid fixtures → **0 approvals** ✓; audit exists before ACTIONABLE ✓; missing audit destination cannot approve ✓; missing Trader action → R6 UNKNOWN (non-actionable, `model_rating` preserved) ✓; missing snapshot → NEEDS_REVIEW ✓; valid complete BUY → APPROVED (with real audit dir) ✓; all baseline regressions pass ✓; no extra network calls by the gate ✓.

## 4. Audit-inclusive latency
Adapter (conversion + one evaluation + durable audit write to a real temp dir), n=200: **p50 = 0.1822 ms, p95 = 0.3563 ms** (threshold p95 ≤ 2000 ms). The benchmark asserts the audit file was actually written.

## 5. Remaining issues
````

```text
def _effective_rating(evaluation: RiskEvaluation) -> str:
    """The effective public rating: the model rating only when APPROVED and
    actionable; otherwise the REVIEW sentinel."""
    if evaluation.verdict == "APPROVED" and evaluation.decision_status == "ACTIONABLE":
        return evaluation.model_rating or RATING_REVIEW
    return RATING_REVIEW


def apply_gate(ticker, trade_date, trader_proposal, portfolio_decision, risk_portfolio=None,
               *, policy=None, audit_dir=None):
    """Evaluate once, persist the durable audit, and return the state updates.

    Returns a dict with ``model_rating``, ``final_rating`` (effective),
    ``risk_verdict``, ``decision_status`` and ``risk_evaluation`` (the
    :class:`RiskEvaluation`). The durable audit is written before an actionable
    rating is returned; if persistence raises, this function propagates the
    failure so no actionable rating is published.
    """
    inputs = _build_inputs_core(ticker, trade_date, trader_proposal, portfolio_decision,
                                risk_portfolio)
    evaluation = evaluate_risk(inputs, policy)

    # Durable audit must be established before an actionable rating can be published.
    # A missing destination must not silently count as successful persistence: an
    # otherwise-APPROVED decision is downgraded to a non-actionable result instead of
    # being published as ACTIONABLE without a durable audit.
    actionable = str(evaluation.verdict) == "APPROVED" and \
        str(evaluation.decision_status) == "ACTIONABLE"
    if actionable and audit_dir is None:
        return {
            "model_rating": evaluation.model_rating,
            "final_rating": RATING_REVIEW,
            "risk_verdict": "NEEDS_REVIEW",
            "decision_status": "PENDING_REVIEW",
            "risk_evaluation": evaluation,
        }
    persist_audit(evaluation, audit_dir)

    return {
        "model_rating": evaluation.model_rating,
        "final_rating": _effective_rating(evaluation),
        "risk_verdict": str(evaluation.verdict),
        "decision_status": str(evaluation.decision_status),
        "risk_evaluation": evaluation,
    }


def _audit_payload(evaluation: RiskEvaluation) -> dict:
    """The serialisable audit record persisted to disk and the state log."""
    return {
        "verdict": str(evaluation.verdict),
        "decision_status": str(evaluation.decision_status),
        "model_rating": evaluation.model_rating,
        "policy_version": evaluation.policy_version,
        "policy_hash": evaluation.policy_hash,
        "evaluated_at_utc": evaluation.evaluated_at_utc,
        "latency_ms": evaluation.latency_ms,
        "evaluated_rule_ids": list(evaluation.evaluated_rule_ids),
        "triggered_violation_ids": list(evaluation.triggered_violation_ids),
        "input_snapshot": dict(evaluation.input_snapshot),
        "rule_results": [
            {
                "rule_id": r.rule_id,
                "outcome": str(r.outcome),
                "detail": r.detail,
                "observed": r.observed,
                "threshold": r.threshold,
            }
            for r in evaluation.rule_results
```
